title: Applied AI Engineer Sales Force - Software Engineer II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Engineer I**
**Role Overview:**
As a Salesforce Applied AI Engineer I , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to building and enhancing high-visibility, full-stack products that serve the business and its users. Your expertise will be pivotal in delighting customers and users, while driving tangible value across Deloitte’s product and AI investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across full-stack software engineering and modern frameworks—together with applied AI fluency that lets you build GenAI and agentic capabilities directly into the products you deliver—consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and ship products end to end, from concept through production.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes—and for the cost of achieving them. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations, and owning the inference, token, and cloud cost of what you build.
* Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, testing, integrations, and support.
* Maintain accountability for code-design integrity, implementation fidelity to architecture and tech stack, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Be hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from discovery to production to operations with all quality checks through SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and UX/UI designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 3 + years of Salesforce experience with most of the following: Apex, LWC, SOQL, SOSL, Flows, REST API/Bulk API, Data Loader/Import Wizard, Salesforce DX as well as automation testing frameworks such Jest, Playwright.
* 2 + years of experience building AI/ML and Salesforce agentic applications, with hands-on Agentforce experience with capabilities such as Data Cloud, Prompt Builder, Prompt Templates, grounding/RAG, actions. Experience with Python is required for AI/ML engineering, automation and agentic applications. Knowledge of React, Angular, Node.js, Java or .Net/C# is preferred.
* 2 + years of experience with designing and delivering cloud-based Salesforce solutions across one or more Salesforce clouds, including secure APIs, event-driven integrations, deployment automation using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions. Knowledge of cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, or micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI is preferred.
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, Salesforce DX, GitHub, SonarQube, Snyk, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly.

**Other:**

* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana, India
  
  
**This role requires working from our local Hyderabad office 2-3x a week**
.
  
  
ABC Fitness is building an intelligent platform for the fitness industry, with AI embedded into the products, workflows, and decision points our customers rely on every day. The AI Platform team builds the foundational capabilities that enable engineering and product teams to safely and reliably develop, deploy, and operate AI-powered experiences.
  
  
This includes the LLM gateway, developer tooling, coding agents, inline guardrails, evaluation frameworks, retrieval capabilities, and the platform services that support production AI use cases. Our customers are the engineers building these systems and the product teams delivering AI features to users.
  
  
As an AI Platform Engineer, you will own platform deliverables end to end. You’ll design, build, launch, instrument, and operate capabilities against clearly defined SLOs. You’ll make adoption easy through clean interfaces, thoughtful migration paths, and documentation that enables teams to use the platform independently.
  
  
You’ll also help establish a clear architectural boundary: mechanism belongs in the request path, while policy sits outside it. The gateway executes routing and other policies but does not define them. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who combines strong platform engineering fundamentals with practical experience building and operating reliable AI systems.
  
  
This is not a model-training or research role. We value demonstrated evidence of ownership and impact over a specific number of years or a previous job title containing “AI.”
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own an AI platform deliverable from problem definition through production launch, adoption, and ongoing operation.
* Design, build, and operate platform capabilities such as LLM gateways, retrieval systems, agents, developer tooling, evaluation frameworks, and inline guardrails.
* Define success criteria and measurable outcomes before building, then use production data and baseline metrics to guide future improvements.
* Design systems with clear SLOs, strong observability, predictable failure handling, and reliable operational processes.
* Develop and maintain clean interfaces, migration paths, documentation, and paved paths that make platform adoption simple for engineering teams.
* Build retrieval and agent systems with a clear separation between retrieval quality and answer quality, supported by meaningful evaluation strategies.
* Design for secure and controlled AI execution, including least-privilege access, multi-tenant isolation, permissioning, auditability, and operational boundaries.
* Apply strong distributed systems principles, including consistency, idempotency, concurrency, resilience, rollout strategies, and failure-mode analysis.
* Use coding agents and other AI development tools effectively while validating their output through testing, review, and sound engineering judgment.
* Carry operational ownership for the systems you build, including participation in an on-call rotation, incident response, and post-incident improvement.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Product, Security, Infrastructure, SRE, and Developer Experience teams to ensure platform capabilities are practical, scalable, and widely adopted.
* Establish and communicate reusable technical patterns, standards, and reference implementations for building production-ready AI systems.

**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**

* Demonstrated experience building or operating production retrieval systems, agent platforms, AI tooling, or other AI-enabled capabilities that real users depend on.
* Strong software engineering experience designing and operating distributed systems within an existing architecture.
* The ability to identify and clearly reason about consistency, idempotency, concurrency, failure modes, multi-tenant isolation, security, and rollout risks.
* Practical understanding of AI system quality, including retrieval evaluation, answer quality, release gates, agent reliability, and cost per request.
* Experience designing systems with clear success criteria, measurable baselines, observability, and operational targets such as SLOs.
* Strong understanding of secure AI execution patterns, including least-privilege access, permissioning, auditability, and policy enforcement.
* Experience taking a platform or product capability from problem definition to production and remaining accountable for its reliability, adoption, and continued improvement.
* Ability to work effectively with coding agents and AI development tools, while independently verifying generated code and recommendations.
* A strong production mindset, including experience with incident response, on-call operations, monitoring, debugging, and post-incident learning.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts accessible to engineering and product stakeholders.
* A customer-focused mindset: you understand that a platform capability that teams do not adopt is not a successful outcome.
* A One Team orientation and a willingness to create reusable capabilities that enable other engineering teams to move faster and more safely.

**AND IT'S GREAT TO HAVE**

* Experience with LLM gateways, agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation systems, or AI developer platforms.
* Experience with FinOps, cost optimization, or usage-based measurement for AI systems.
* Experience in application security, policy enforcement, identity, access management, or secure platform design.
* Experience with search quality, ranking, experimentation, or relevance evaluation.
* Experience with OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, AI observability, or production telemetry.
* Experience building multi-tenant infrastructure or internal developer platforms.
* Experience with developer advocacy, technical enablement, SDKs, documentation, or helping teams adopt new engineering capabilities.
* Familiarity with routing systems, API gateways, service orchestration, workflow engines, or platform control planes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You own at least one platform deliverable end to end, with clear success criteria, measurable baseline metrics, and a stated SLO.
* Engineering teams can adopt the capability through a clean interface, clear documentation, and a practical migration path without requiring ongoing support from you.
* AI platform releases are evaluated using meaningful quality, reliability, latency, adoption, and cost metrics.
* Retrieval quality, answer quality, agent behavior, and production reliability are measured separately and improved deliberately.
* Agents and AI systems operate with least-privilege access, appropriate isolation, strong observability, and clear operational controls.
* The platform remains reliable in production, with effective incident response, clear ownership, and continuous improvement after failures.
* Engineers and product teams use the platform to deliver AI-powered capabilities faster, more safely, and with greater confidence.
* Within your first 90 days, you own a platform deliverable and understand your team’s baseline metrics—not only its target outcomes.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

title: Software Dev Engineer
description:
**Description**
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is hiring a Software Development Engineer II to join the Associate Experience team. Our organization is at the forefront of customer experience — seeking to delight our customers in every interaction they have, whether through self-serve technology and tools (e.g., chatbots), or by interacting directly with our Customer Service Associates (CSA).
  
  
Customer Service works to offer effective, empathetic, and efficient issue resolution when our customers need us, and we are also champions of driving defects out of customer experiences across the entire company, relentlessly advocating on behalf of customers and keeping them at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer II on this team, you will design, develop, and own comprehensive customer engagement services and solutions that anticipate and resolve customer questions at global scale. You will partner with cross-functional teams to drive technical strategy and improvements to our technology platform, owning systems that power the ultimate customer service experience. You will also contribute to engineering best practices and mentor junior engineers on the team. You should be somebody who thrives on solving difficult technical problems, designing scalable solutions, and feels strongly about building reliable software with a customer-centric mindset.
  
  
We use Scrum, test-driven development, and continuous deployment to deliver projects by making effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. If you are results-oriented, data-driven, and passionate about creating innovative customer experiences through technology, we would love to connect with you.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, develop, and own software services and tools that solve difficult business and operational problems, delivering with a focus on simplicity and scalability
  
  
Optimize and enhance existing systems for performance, reliability, and maintainability at Amazon scale
  
  
Make informed technical decisions on system design, technology selection, and problem-solving approaches with limited guidance
  
  
Identify and mitigate technical risks early in the development lifecycle, escalating when appropriate
  
  
Partner with engineers and cross-functional teams to contribute to design reviews, align on technical direction, and drive improvements across team boundaries
  
  
Make effective trade-offs between time, quality, and resources to deliver high-quality results within project timelines
  
  
Track, analyze, and act on key metrics to optimize system performance and drive continuous improvement
  
  
Identify and implement engineering process improvements, contributing to operational excellence and best practices across the team
  
  
Mentor junior engineers by providing technical guidance, conducting code reviews, and fostering a culture of learning and high standards
  
  
Write clear technical documentation, including design documents and operational runbooks, to support system ownership and team knowledge sharing
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer II on the Associate Experience team, no two days look exactly the same — but each one centers on building technology that makes a real difference for Customer Service Associates (CSAs) and the customers they serve. You might start your morning reviewing metrics from a recent deployment, analyzing how a feature you own is performing at scale and identifying areas for optimization. Then you could be deep in a design review with your team, debating trade-offs between approaches for a new generative AI-powered automation feature. After that, you shift to hands-on coding — writing, testing, and shipping production-quality code using test-driven development and continuous deployment practices. Throughout the day, you collaborate with product managers and other SDEs to shape technical direction and translate customer needs into scalable solutions. You also make time to review pull requests from teammates and mentor junior engineers on best practices. Some days involve investigating and resolving production issues, making quick decisions to mitigate risks and keep systems running reliably. By end of day, you have contributed meaningfully to services that touch millions of customer interactions worldwide.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Associate Experience team develops products to support Amazon's Customer Service Associates (CSAs) in delivering seamless customer service. Our mission is to empower CSAs with intelligent solutions — powered by generative AI, machine learning, and automation — that anticipate customer needs and accelerate issue resolution at global scale. We build AI assistants, contact automation, and real-time insight tools that reduce CSA effort and improve the customer experience with every interaction. Our team values innovation, ownership, and collaboration, and you will have the opportunity to work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about using cutting-edge technology to make a meaningful impact on how millions of customers experience Amazon support.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**

description:

At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The Schwab Asset Management (SAM) Technology organization is a part of Schwab Technology Services that is responsible for Schwab's investment management, operations, data, and research platforms. Everything that SAM Tech builds serves Schwab’s mission of helping clients reach their financial goals.
  
  
As a Sr. Manager, Software Development and Engineering - Research Technology in the SAM Investment Research Technology group, you will lead of team of engineering professionals focused on delivering cutting-edge research, data, distribution, and AI enablement capabilities designed to advance SAM business opportunities and to support the Schwab Center for Financial Research (SCFR) in its mission to provide clients and advisors actionable investment advice. We curate datasets for both exploratory and product-focused research, we implement and maintain investment models, we maintain asset allocation schema and asset classification workflows, and we systematically deliver these datasets to downstream clients and AI applications throughout the enterprise. This role will be responsible for the ongoing operation and modernization of our research and distribution platforms and for delivering new models, data, and other capabilities into production. The Investment Research Technology Group operates within a mature Agile and DevOps model in partnership with our business stakeholders, requiring active engagement with Product Owners, Researchers, Architects, and other partners — in managing requirements, design, coding, testing (unit and functional), deployment, and post-release support.
  
  
▪ Lead a team of engineering professionals responsible for creating and delivering data platforms, models, and other quantitative research capabilities used by SAM/SCFR researchers to develop cutting-edge investment products
  
  
▪ Leverage your knowledge of the investment management domain to interface with business partners in SAM and SCFR and associated Schwab enterprises to gather, refine, and interpret business and technical requirements
  
  
▪ Represent SAM Investment Research Tech in cross-functional forums to negotiate program priorities, resourcing, and trade-offs
  
  
▪ Provide technical leadership in designing and implementing modern data platforms spanning multiple asset classes and serving the needs of diverse research teams
  
  
▪ Oversee delivery and ongoing enhancements to full-stack applications utilized by business users to oversee data production activities and provide data validation for large datasets
  
  
▪ Implement and support model operations processes and controls to enable efficient and reproducible research and provide post-release model monitoring
  
  
▪Build data visualizations and other tooling to enable model researchers to efficiently monitor model performance and stability, as well as to interpret model outputs.
  
  
▪ Assist in selection and integration of data related tools, frameworks, and applications required to expand platform capabilities
  
  
▪ Lead proof-of-concepts to understand the appropriateness of new methodologies and/or technologies for our platforms
  
  
▪ Build high-performing, collaborative development teams that deliver predictably within the Agile framework as well as operate effectively within the broader Schwab technology organization
  
  
▪ Develop and motivate individual engineering staff to deliver high-quality solutions that meet the needs of clients and business partners
  
  
▪ Support staff in career development to unlock long-term value for the organization.
  
  
▪ Promote and sustain a culture of engineering excellence with a focus on quality and transparency
  
  
▪ Operate successfully within the Schwab technology ecosystem, partnering with architects, engineers, business analysts, scrum masters, and other infrastructure, security, and governance teams to deliver products in compliance with enterprise standards
  
  
▪ Be a champion of new ways of collaborating with technology and business partners
  
  
▪ Influence and implement improvements and efficiencies in both the technical and non-technical aspects of the development process
  
  
**Required Qualification**
▪ Degree in computer science, information systems, math, engineering, or other technical field, or equivalent experience
  
  
▪ Six or more years of software engineering experience focused on data-intensive systems leveraging Python, Java and/or similar languages (e.g. R, Matlab, Julia)
  
  
▪ Experience building and leading technical teams delivering high-quality software in a regulated operating environment
  
  
▪ Experience growing mature, high-performing engineering teams, including talent management, coaching, and career development
  
  
▪ Strong communication skills and ability to drive alignment and consensus both within and across teams/organizations
  
  
▪ Experience collaborating with investment teams to support research workflows, data analysis, model development, and data distribution activities
  
  
▪ Proven ability designing, developing, and operating data-intensive systems processing large financial datasets, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and timely data delivery
  
  
▪ Proficiency in designing and implementing data models to support efficient data storage, integration, and retrieval of financial datasets
  
  
▪ Foundational understanding of modern AI architectures, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  
  
▪ Understanding of data quality frameworks and controls, including monitoring, validation, lineage tracking, and governance processes to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and reliability
  
  
▪ Experience leveraging continuous integration/development tools (e.g. Jenkins, Docker, Containers, OpenShift, Kubernetes, and container automation) in a CI/CD pipeline
  
  
▪ Proficiency building integration and regression testing frameworks to ensure system stability and performance
  
  
▪ Proven ability to partner with researchers, product leaders, and technology stakeholders to negotiate priorities and deliver business value
  
  
▪ Experience managing complex technology portfolios, balancing innovation, operational reliability, and regulatory constraints
  
  
▪ Demonstrated capability to lead and motivate technical teams by building trust and emphasizing transparency in decision-making
  
  
**Preffered Qualification**
▪ Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, quantitative finance, or a related technical discipline
  
  
▪ Demonstrated ability to influence technical and business strategy through deep domain expertise, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional leadership.
  
  
▪ Experience leading platform modernization, cloud adoption, or large-scale technology transformation initiatives within a regulated financial services environment.
  
  
▪ Hands-on experience with modern data lake platforms and architectures supporting investment management use cases, including the ingestion, storage, governance, and consumption of structured and unstructured datasets; Snowflake experience a plus
  
  
▪ Experience designing and implementing distributed compute architectures to enable scalable, high-throughput data workflows and analytics
  
  
▪ Experience delivering capabilities for AI enablement, such as MCP Servers, RAG indexes, etc.
  
  
▪ Track record of identifying and implementing innovative technologies, engineering practices, or process improvements that increase team effectiveness
  
  
▪ Experience communicating complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, including senior business and technology leaders
  
  
▪ Proven ability to build organizational capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and the development of technical talent across teams
  
  
▪ Experience synthesizing input from multiple stakeholders to balance competing priorities, drive alignment, and create achievable implementation plans
  
  
▪ Familiarity with quantitative investment research methodologies, including factor modeling, portfolio construction, risk analytics, performance attribution, or backtesting
  
  
What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.
  
  
**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day-to-day work

description:

**Job Description**
***This is a Permanent full-time role with our Esteem Customer***
**Company Profile**
We are a leader in Audio AI, Noise Cancellation, Speaker ID and other Audio Analytics technologies. It has over 75+ patents granted and pending in this Audio AI & analytics technologies. we pioneer with over 20+ years of experience in Audio solutions, is a spin-off of the former media processing and real-time communications group of Imagination Technologies, is the recognized leader in IP Communications and Voice IoT technology platforms for voice, video and messaging applications. To see how we is helping top-tier OEM, IC, Call Centers and carrier customers, with embedded software, mobile apps and end-to-end communications solutions
  
  
**Job Title**
: Research Scientist - Speech AI
  
  
**Exp**
: 4+ Years in AI/ML with strong hands-on experience in speech/Audio/Voice AI
  
  
**Who We’re Looking For**
We’re looking for Research Scientists with strong hands-on experience in Voice AI. Depending on your strengths, this might mean independently building, evaluating, optimizing, and deploying production-grade speech/audio models – or formulating research problems, designing rigorous experiments, developing novel approaches, and driving projects toward state-of-the-art results and publications/patents where appropriate. Most Research Scientists here do a mix of both.
  
  
Candidates may apply against anyone (or more) of the following problem tracks, based on their interest and prior experience. Across every track, you will
  
  

* Drive AI research and innovation in Speech/Audio AI
* Translate research questions into measurable hypotheses; design rigorous experiments and ablations, analyze model behavior and failure modes, reproduce and build on relevant papers
* Take research from prototype to production-grade, deployable systems
* Define appropriate objective and subjective evaluation metrics, and run benchmarking, error analysis, and statistical comparisons to know when a model is actually better – not just different
* Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and DSP/embedded teams
* Bring strong problem-solving ability – debug, iterate, and optimize models under real-world constraints
* Stay current with SOTA literature and bring new techniques into the team, publish or patent where appropriate

***Track 1: Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)***

* Work on end-to-end ASR architectures (Transformer, Conformer, RNN-T) for streaming speech recognition
* Work with speech foundation models (Whisper-style architectures) and self-supervised models (HuBERT, wav2vec 2.0, WavLM) for representation learning and fine-tuning
* Own the end-to-end ASR pipeline – preprocessing, feature extraction, acoustic modeling, and decoding/language modeling
* Research streaming and causal architectures under strict latency constraints
* Improve robustness under noisy, multi-accent, and low-resource conditions – starting with Indian-English / regional Indian accents, with a roadmap to scale to international accents and languages
* Research accent-invariant / accent-normalized representations – removing accent information from learned embeddings to improve generalization across accents and geographies
* Study representation quality and robustness across speakers, accents, recording conditions, and domains
* Evaluated on: WER, CER, RTF, latency, memory
* Preferred background: prior work on CTC/RNN-T, self-supervised pretraining, or Whisper finetuning 2

***Track 2: Text-to-Speech (TTS)***

* Work on flow-matching / diffusion-based TTS systems (in the spirit of CosyVoice, ZipVoice, VITS, and similar SOTA architectures) for real-time, low-compute synthesis
* Experience with duration-controlled, time-aligned TTS using forced alignment (e.g., MFA) and Monotonic Alignment Search (MAS) for multi-speaker settings
* Research controllable accent adaptation using speaker, accent, linguistic, prosodic, and/or style representations – including decoder-side conditioning and representation-level approaches – starting with Indian-English and US-English accent pairs and scaling to international accents
* Research controllable duration, timing, rhythm, F0, and prosody modelling for natural accent rendering.
* Improve naturalness, prosody, and voice-cloning quality
* Optimize inference for real-time, streaming synthesis on constrained hardware
* Evaluated on: MOS, speaker similarity, intelligibility, prosody, RTF
* Preferred background: prior work with neural vocoders, diffusion/flow-matching TTS, or zeroshot voice cloning

***Track 3: Speech Enhancement / Noise Suppression***

* Develop time-domain, spectral-domain, and hybrid speech enhancement models for real-time applications
* Work across both single-microphone and multi-microphone / multi-channel scenarios, including beamforming-informed approaches
* Improve performance in low-SNR, reverberant, and non-stationary noise conditions
* Evaluate using objective and perceptual metrics under challenging real-world acoustic conditions
* Optimize for low latency and low compute for edge / embedded deployment
* Evaluated on: SI-SDR, PESQ, STOI, DNSMOS, latency, compute
* Preferred background: prior work on single- or multi-channel speech enhancement, beamforming, or DNS Challenge-style benchmarks

***Track 4: Model Optimization***

* Work on quantization (including quantization-aware training), pruning, and knowledge distillation for speech/audio models
* Optimize inference pipelines (e.g., ONNX / TensorRT-class toolchains) for low-latency, lowpower edge and embedded deployment 3
* Profile end-to-end pipelines across CPU/GPU/NPU targets to identify model- and system-level bottlenecks – the neural network isn’t always the actual latency bottleneck
* Benchmark and profile models across hardware platforms, balancing latency, throughput, and memory trade-offs
* Preferred background: prior work with model compression, quantization-aware training, or on device inference

**Also of interest**
We’re also excited about adjacent problems – target speaker extraction, accent conversion, source separation, bandwidth extension, and packet loss concealment, Speech Translation. If you’ve worked on any of these, tell us about it.
  
  
**Core Skills / Qualifications Required**

* Strong programming skills in Python and AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow)
* Strong ML/DL fundamentals, including CNNs, RNNs, LSTMs, and Transformers applied to speech/audio
* Good understanding of signal processing, linear algebra, optimization techniques, statistics, and pattern recognition
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in the Audio/Speech/Voice AI domain
* Ability to independently design and run experiments; strong debugging and analytical skills
* Self-motivated to learn, explore new areas, and work independently
* Hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts, including GANs, Flow Matching, and Diffusion Models.

**Nice To Have**

* Working knowledge of C/C++ and CUDA (required for Track 4: Model Optimization)
* Experience with ONNX/TensorRT, Kaldi, ESPnet, NeMo, or Hugging Face
* Experience with embedded/edge deployment
* Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in speech/audio

We value strong fundamentals, research thinking, experimental rigor, and problem-solving ability over familiarity with any specific framework or model architecture.
  
  
**Qualification**
Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD in AI/ML, CSE, ECE, or related field

title: Python Architect (C2H)
description:
Our customer is seeking an exceptional Python Architect to design and build the software backbone of the platform that powers our real-time analytics, AI/ML initiatives, and enterprise reporting for the automotive service industry. This is not a scripting role. We are looking for an engineer who treats Python as a first-class software engineering language: someone who designs layered, extensible systems, writes libraries other engineers build on, and can reason about concurrency, memory, performance, and maintainability at scale.

You will turn long-running, manual, and tribal-knowledge processes into well-architected, tested, and observable Python services and frameworks that run against high-volume operational data — on the order of hundreds of thousands of repair-order records per day — flowing through our AWS and Snowflake ecosystem.

Most important: deep, demonstrable Python mastery and a track record of architecting complex Python systems (frameworks, SDKs, distributed processing engines, or plugin-based platforms). We will trade breadth of data-platform tooling for depth in Python; Snowflake, Airflow, and AWS specifics can be learned on the job.

* **Experience**
  : 10+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 7 years building production systems primarily in Python.
* **Python mastery (primary)**
  : Expert-level command of the language and its internals — data model, typing system, iterators/generators, decorators, descriptors, metaclasses, context managers, memory model, and the GIL. You can explain why, not just how.
* **Complex Python architecture**
  : Proven experience designing and owning large, multi-module Python codebases or frameworks used by other engineers — not only standalone scripts or notebooks.
* **Concurrency & performance**
  : Hands-on production experience with asyncio and/or multiprocessing, and a track record of profiling and measurably improving the speed or memory footprint of Python systems.
* **Testing discipline**
  : Deep experience with pytest and test design for complex systems, including mocking strategy, integration testing, and test-driven development.
* **Data handling**
  : Strong experience processing large datasets in Python (Polars, pandas, PyArrow, DuckDB, or similar), dataframe and schema validation (Pandera or Pydantic), and solid working SQL.
* **Modern Python ecosystem**
  : Current with Python 3.12+ and modern tooling — uv, ruff, pyright/mypy, Pydantic v2, async-native libraries (httpx, asyncpg/aiohttp) — and able to evaluate new runtime features critically.
* **Engineering practices**
  : Git-based workflows, CI/CD, packaging and dependency management, containerization, and strong documentation habits (design docs, READMEs, runbooks).
* **Data platform exposure**
  : Experience with Snowflake, Airflow (including custom operators/DAG factories), dbt, or Databricks/PySpark is preferred.
* **AWS & event-driven systems**
  : Hands-on use of S3, Lambda, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, or ECS from Python, including idempotent consumers for Kafka, Kinesis, or SQS is added advantage.
* **Performance extensions**
  : Experience with Cython, Rust bindings (PyO3), or Numba, or with running workloads on the free-threaded CPython build is added advantage.
* **LLM & agent frameworks**
  : Hands-on experience with MCP server development, LangGraph, Pydantic AI, or similar agent frameworks, and with LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, or AWS Bedrock is added advantage.
* **Automotive domain**
  : Familiarity with repair-order, dealership fixed-operations, or DMS data is a plus.

Because this role centers on Python architecture, we ask every candidate to include a short write-up (one page or less) or a link to code that answers the following:

* **A complex Python system you architected**
  : What problem did it solve, how was it structured (modules, layers, key abstractions), and why did you choose that design over the alternatives?
* **Scale and performance**
  : What were the volume, concurrency, or latency constraints, and how did you profile and optimize the system to meet them?
* **Extensibility and quality**
  : How did other engineers extend your code, how did you keep it tested and maintainable, and what would you design differently today?
* **AI in your workflow**
  : How do you use AI coding assistants or LLM-powered tooling in your engineering work, and how do you keep the output production-quality?
* Shortlisted candidates should expect a technical interview that includes a live architecture discussion and an in-depth review of real Python code.

title: Contact Center Architect

* AI-Native Engineering: Champion AI-assisted development practices by heavily utilizing Claude Code and other agentic developer CLI tools to rapidly scaffold, test, and refactor code.
* Agent Reliability & Guardrails: Implement safety guardrails, schema validation, structured output enforcement, and automated agent evaluation suites (evaluating tool-call accuracy, task completion, and hallucination rates).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Core Engineering Experience: 4+ years of professional backend software engineering in Python, with strong proficiency in asynchronous programming (asyncio, httpx), OOP, and clean architecture.
* Agentic Frameworks: 2+ years of hands-on experience building autonomous agents and stateful graphs using LangGraph (managing checkpointers, state schemas, and branch conditions) and LangChain.
* Model Context Protocol (MCP): Hands-on experience building, debugging, and deploying custom MCP servers (Stdio/SSE transports) and connecting them to agent runtimes.
* Modern Agentic Tooling: Daily fluency with Claude Code or comparable agentic CLI tools for automated testing, debugging, and rapid development.
* Structured Outputs & Tool Calling: Deep understanding of function/tool calling mechanics and schema enforcement libraries (e.g., Pydantic, Instructor, JSON Schema).
* RAG & Search: Solid foundation in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures: hybrid search (dense embeddings + sparse keyword search), re-ranking, and production vector stores (e.g., Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, or pgvector).
* System Design & Resilience: Strong system design fundamentals: API authentication, asynchronous task queues (Celery/Redis), rate-limiting, and error-recovery patterns for non-deterministic systems.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* In-House LLM Serving: Experience integrating with or deploying local/open-source models using engines like vLLM, Ollama, or Triton Inference Server on internal GPU infrastructure.
* Observability & LLMOps: Experience setting up end-to-end agent tracing, cost analysis, and evaluation frameworks using LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry.
* Cloud Platforms: Experience running and containerizing AI services on AWS, Azure, or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes.
* MCP Open Source Ecosystem: Active contributor to or early adopter of the open-source MCP community and servers.
* Frontend Basics: Working familiarity with frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, or Tailwind) to quickly prototype internal agent-interaction UIs.

* Strong data engineering experience with scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT frameworks, structured and unstructured data processing, cloud data platforms, and distributed data-processing solutions.
* Experience with technologies including AWS Glue, Amazon S3, Redshift, Athena, Spark, Databricks, Airflow/Step Functions, and Kafka/Kinesis.

* Experience defining AI evaluation strategies encompassing groundedness, retrieval relevance, hallucination, tool execution, security, privacy, latency, cost, guardrails, and human oversight.
* Strong experience with Docker, Terraform/AWS CDK, Git, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, tracing, alerting, and observability.

title: AI Engineer- Team Lead
description:
**Description**
**What We're Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to join our AI engineering team in Hyderabad. The team is new and built around strong early-career engineers - what it needs now is senior craft alongside them.
  
  
Our goal is to automate expert work for two audiences. Internally, we build AI systems that let teams across the company produce more and better work in less time. Externally, we build custom AI solutions for enterprise customers - bespoke enrichment pipelines, data feeds, and automated workflows shaped around a specific customer's problem. The internal tools we build usually become the foundation of what we sell.
  
  
AI engineers and software engineers build and jointly own our solutions. You will work alongside them from problem framing and prototyping through production and iteration, and help set the engineering bar for a team that is still forming it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Build and ship AI systems**

* Design, build, and operate LLM-powered agents and multi-step workflows - tool use, planning, state and memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and sensible recovery when a step fails.
* Build forward-engineering agents: systems that take an ambiguous customer or business input and produce working technical output - queries, configurations, enrichment logic, briefs - that internal teams and customers then rely on.
* Take solutions into production and keep them healthy - deploy, monitor, and optimize for reliability and cost together.

**Get the quality right**

* Do prompt engineering properly: task decomposition, context design, structured outputs, tools and schemas, and the right model for each step. We treat prompts as engineering artifacts - versioned and reviewed like code.
* Build evaluation into the work - golden datasets, regression suites, and the metrics that matter for each workflow: accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, latency, and cost per unit of work.
* Know when an LLM is not the answer, and when retrieval, a classical model, or plain deterministic code is better.

**Lift the team**

* Mentor early-career engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussion. Most of the team is within a year of graduating and learns fast when it is taught well.
* Help set the standards the team works to - testing, prompt and evaluation conventions, observability, and what “done” means for an AI feature.
* Work with product managers, platform engineers, and the teams who use what we build, across several time zones - translating fuzzy requirements into a technical approach with the trade-offs stated plainly.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4-9 years in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related technical role, including hands-on experience taking AI-powered applications into production.
* A system you have built and operated where an LLM did real work - and a clear sense of how you knew it was working, what broke, and what you changed.
* Strong Python and solid software engineering fundamentals, with a good understanding of API design and integration patterns.
* Practical experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP-based tooling, or equivalent) and with frontier model APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable).
* Working knowledge of RAG, vector and keyword search (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or equivalent) for grounding models in proprietary data.
* A solid grounding in traditional ML alongside the generative side - classification, clustering, embeddings, feature engineering, and standard evaluation methodology - and the judgment to pick a classical model when it is faster, cheaper, and more predictable than a prompt.
* Experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), containers, and CI/CD.
* Some experience mentoring or technically guiding less-experienced engineers.
* Clear communication and comfort with ambiguity - a working prototype that proves the idea, then the engineering to make it durable.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or an equivalent degree.

**Nice to Have**

* Large-scale LLM enrichment or classification pipelines, where cost and quality per document both matter.
* A background in NLP, information retrieval, or media and text analytics.
* Transformers, fine-tuning, PyTorch or TensorFlow; or computer vision and speech-to-text in production.

**Why This Role**
The team is new, the problem space is genuinely unsolved, and the work goes straight into the hands of people who depend on it daily. You will shape how a team builds AI systems rather than maintain someone else's decisions.
  
  
*You do not need every item on this list. If you are strong across most of it and curious about the rest, we would like to hear from you.*
**What We Offer:**

* Enjoy flexible paid time off options for enhanced work-life balance.
* Comprehensive health insurance tailored for you.
* Employee assistance programs cover mental health, legal, financial, wellness, and behaviour areas to ensure your overall well-being.
* Complimentary Calm App subscription for you and your loved ones, because mental wellness matters.

title: Principal Agentic Engineer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**About The Team**
Tech@Lilly builds and maintains capabilities using pioneering technologies like the most prominent tech companies. What differentiates Lilly IT is that we redefine what's possible through tech to advance our purpose, creating medicines that make life better for people around the world, including data-driven drug discovery, connected clinical trials, resilient enterprise platforms, and intelligent digital operations. We hire the best technology professionals from a variety of backgrounds, so they can bring an assortment of knowledge, skills, and diverse thinking to deliver creative solutions in every area of our business.
  
  
The Digital Core team leads Lilly's transformation into the Digital and AI era. They inspire digitally empowered teams to new ways of working and accelerate innovation and agility. This team powers and advances the entire company by building and maintaining world-class technology capabilities and platforms.
  
  
Lilly Capability Centre India (LCCI), Hyderabad, is Lilly's premier Global Technology Hub, harnessing data, AI, analytics, and digital solutions to revolutionize healthcare and improve patient outcomes worldwide.
  
  
**Role Summary**
You own the agentic resolution platform end to end — both the cloud-native substrate it runs on and the intelligent agents that run on top of it. From Kubernetes, CI/CD, and observability through agent runtime, LLM patterns, retrieval, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop boundaries, you write the production code, design the architecture, and set the engineering bar that lets automation deflect routine operational work before it ever reaches a human.
  
  
This is a senior individual-contributor role that is both strategic and deeply hands-on. You ship production platform services and agentic capabilities, make the build-vs-buy calls on tooling and model access, and partner with the senior architect on the patterns that scale. Success is measured by rising deflection, sustained toil reduction, platform availability and developer velocity, and the ability to scale agentic intelligence through systems and people — not individual effort.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Agentic resolution platform — intake to action
* Architect the agentic resolution platform end to end: intake, classification, action execution, verification, and human-in-the-loop fallback.
* Build the agent runtime and orchestration layer: agent state and memory, tool integration, multi-agent coordination patterns, and confidence-thresholded handoffs to humans.
* Define agent-decision observability, audit-ready posture, and the data contracts that let the platform consume durable fixes from upstream engineering teams.
* LLM application patterns, knowledge, and evaluation rigor
* Design production LLM patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, multi-model routing, and hybrid retrieval over the knowledge corpus.
* Own the knowledge-base strategy as a compounding deflection lever — every resolved incident becomes training data and structured retrieval input for future automation.
* Establish evaluation and guardrail frameworks for non-deterministic systems: automated evals, quality scoring, drift detection, and feedback loops that compound agent quality over time.
* Cloud-native platform — build and operate
* Architect and operate Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale for container and serverless workloads supporting agentic and LLM inference traffic patterns.
* Write production platform services and internal tooling (Python or Go) that automate provisioning, deployment, and operational workflows — not just infrastructure configuration.
* Define and maintain infrastructure as code (Terraform) integrated with a major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI), with secrets management and audit-ready posture for regulated environments.
* CI/CD, observability, and developer experience
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines tuned for agentic and AI workloads: model and agent versioning, canary rollouts, evaluation gates, and rollback.
* Own the observability stack (Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry plus enterprise tooling) and instrument platform health, agent-decision telemetry, and model-inference metrics.
* Establish SLOs, SLIs, and reliability standards for both platform and agentic system health; design self-service patterns and golden-path templates that accelerate delivery.
* Cross-team partnership, security, and talent development
* Partner with the Reliability Engineering team on which production patterns become agent-assisted automations, and with senior architects on the patterns that scale.
* Own security posture: network policies, pod security, secrets rotation, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in a regulated pharmaceutical environment.
* Set the engineering bar through code quality standards, architectural reviews, and role modeling; mentor senior engineers in agentic AI, LLM application patterns, and platform engineering. Influence engineering leaders to adopt automation-friendly patterns at the source, not just downstream.

**How You Will Succeed**

* Be recognized as the senior technical authority for agentic platform engineering in your area.
* Demonstrate measurable, sustained improvements: rising deflection rates, reduced toil, fewer recurring incidents, faster resolution, platform uptime, and deployment velocity.
* Ship production platform services and agentic capabilities that tangibly move the deflection and developer-experience numbers.
* Scale agentic intelligence through systems, standards, and people — not individual heroics.

**Required**
**What you should bring**

* 10+ years of progressive technology experience with substantial hands-on architecture and delivery of automation, AIOps, agentic systems, or cloud-native platforms at enterprise scale.
* Demonstrated ownership of measurable deflection or operational-toil-reduction outcomes in a production environment — with the numbers to show it.
* Deep technical fluency in agentic system design: agent runtimes, multi-agent orchestration, tool integration, memory and state management. Practical experience with at least one major framework (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or MCP).
* Production experience with LLM application patterns: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, and multi-model routing.
* Deep cloud-native background: Kubernetes (EKS or equivalent) at scale, container workloads, infrastructure as code (Terraform), and at least one major cloud's AI stack (AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure AI Foundry, or Vertex AI).
* Proven ability to build and ship production platform services and tooling — not just configure infrastructure. Expert-level Python (async, packaging, performance) for production services; Go also welcome.
* Strong CI/CD engineering experience for AI and agentic workloads: model and agent deployment, versioning, canary/blue-green strategies, evaluation gates, and rollback.
* Observability for AI systems: metrics, logs, traces, and agent-decision telemetry using Prometheus/Grafana/OpenTelemetry, plus at least one enterprise stack (Splunk, Datadog, or Dynatrace).
* Demonstrated rigor in evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic systems — automated evals, drift detection, human-in-the-loop verification, and feedback loops.
* Strong security engineering foundation: network policies, secrets management, vulnerability scanning, and access controls in regulated environments.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
* Exceptional communication skills, including the ability to translate technical strategy for senior business and technology leadership.

*This is a hybrid role spanning agentic AI, LLM patterns, cloud-native platform, and developer tooling. We expect strong depth in 2–3 of these areas with the breadth and judgment to learn adjacent domains. Not every tool listed is required.*
**Preferred**

* Working knowledge of operational ML: anomaly detection, event correlation, alert-noise reduction, and model/agent monitoring in production.
* Experience with AI observability tooling (e.g., LangSmith, Weights & Biases, custom telemetry pipelines).
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow integration patterns and chat-based intake platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams).
* Experience with vector databases and hybrid retrieval architectures.
* Experience building internal developer platforms (IDP), self-service provisioning, or platform-as-a-product tooling.
* Backend development skills beyond infrastructure tooling: REST/gRPC API design, database design, message queues, distributed systems patterns.
* Experience with policy-as-code, automated compliance checks, or shift-left security tooling.
* AWS cloud platform fluency, including EKS, Bedrock, SageMaker, and cost-optimization tooling.
* Familiarity with FinOps practices and cloud cost governance.
* Experience operating in highly regulated industries (life sciences, financial services, healthcare).
* Prior experience standing up a new engineering capability from a small founding team.
* Frontend experience (React, TypeScript) for internal dashboards and developer portals.

**Leadership expectations**

* Acts with enterprise-first mindset, beyond individual products or teams.
* Drives accountability, clarity, and engineering rigor across the team.
* Builds trust through consistency, technical depth, and follow-through.
* Raises the capability of the organization, not just personal output.
* Leads through what they build and how they write, not through org-chart authority.

**Additional Information**
Availability to work flexible work hours is/may be required. This team supports continuous operations and may require non-standard work hours, including some work on weekends and holidays. Appropriate adjustments in benefits will be provided for employees working non-standard hours where applicable.
  
  
This is an onsite role based in Hyderabad. Candidates should be open to working different shifts when required to align with global delivery partners.
