title: Robotics Research Engineer (L4) - Physical AI & Robot Learning
description:
**Robotics Research Engineer (L4) — Physical AI & Robot Learning**

**Hyderabad, India · Full-time · On-site with real robots**

**Build Intelligence That Holds Up in the Physical World**

A robot can follow a programmed trajectory. The harder challenge is helping it work when the world does not match the plan: a connector is slightly misaligned, a component arrives in a different pose, or parts in a bin are partially hidden from view.

Perceptyne builds industrial humanoid robots for physical work such as assembly, manipulation, and packaging. Making these robots more capable requires advances not only in AI models, but also in perception, control, data collection, evaluation, and the software that brings those pieces together on real hardware.

We are looking for a senior, hands-on Physical AI engineer to help advance that work. You will explore promising approaches in robot learning, adapt and integrate them with Perceptyne’s robots, and contribute to the evolution of PR-PhI, our modular robot-intelligence platform. Where it makes sense, you will also help investigate new models tailored to our robots and tasks.

You will report to the founders and begin as a senior individual contributor. You will work alongside our existing AI/ML and robotics engineers, contribute directly to critical code and experiments, and be part of shaping the technical direction as the team grows. This is a role for someone who brings depth and judgment to a collaborative engineering effort—not someone arriving to replace the expertise already here.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

Your work will span research, software architecture, experiments, and deployment on physical robots. You will collaborate closely with engineers across AI/ML, manipulation, computer vision, controls, embedded systems, and mechanical design.

* Be part of defining priorities and technical approaches for robot learning and Physical AI.
* Evaluate promising robot-learning and physical-intelligence models on Perceptyne hardware. Identify where they work, where they fail, and what it would take to make them useful in practice.
* Adapt, fine-tune, integrate, and deploy selected models for our robot configurations, sensors, action spaces, and manipulation tasks.
* Compare learned approaches against practical alternatives—including classical computer vision, motion planning, visual servoing, force-based control, and task-specific skills—and use the approach that best serves the task.
* Contribute to the architecture and implementation of PR-PhI, connecting perception, robot state, learned policies, planning, skill execution, monitoring, verification, and recovery.
* Set-up new and strengthen our existing data-collection and experimentation workflows, including teleoperation, synchronized sensor and robot-state logging, demonstrations, interventions, dataset quality, versioning, and reproducibility.
* Design meaningful real-robot evaluations that measure task success, robustness to variation, cycle time, intervention needs, latency, and failure modes—not just offline model metrics.
* Build reliable training and inference pipelines, and work through the practical constraints of serving models on robots. Cloud infrastructure may be used where appropriate, with attention to longer-term deployment on local or on-premises compute.
* Work with the broader robotics team to define safe operating boundaries, failure detection, fallbacks, and appropriate human involvement for experimental and deployed capabilities.
* Read and test relevant research quickly, while helping the team distinguish promising results from approaches that are not yet practical for our hardware or customer tasks.
* Write high-quality code, review designs and experiments with peers, mentor engineers through technical collaboration, and help grow the team’s collective capability.
* Explore proprietary model development where experimental results and real-world needs make a convincing case for it.

**What We’re Looking For**

You are a strong engineer with experience at the intersection of machine learning and physical robots. You enjoy ambitious research questions, but you are equally comfortable investigating a calibration error, improving a data pipeline, or debugging why a policy fails on hardware.

* 5+ years of relevant experience in robot learning, embodied AI, manipulation, applied ML for robotics, autonomous systems, or a closely related area and 8+ years of overall software / product related work experience. We care more about the depth of your work than an exact year count or previous title.
* Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, evaluating, or deploying learned behavior on real robots. Simulation and offline research experience are valuable, but are not sufficient on their own for this role.
* Strong Python and modern ML-framework skills, particularly PyTorch or JAX. Ability to write maintainable, performant code; C++ experience is valuable.
* Practical familiarity with relevant approaches such as imitation learning, behavior cloning, diffusion or flow-based policies, vision-language-action models, reinforcement learning, or multimodal perception-action systems.
* Sound robotics fundamentals: coordinate frames, kinematics, calibration, cameras, robot state, action representations, control interfaces, grasping, contact-rich manipulation, latency, and failure recovery.
* Experience with robot-learning data: demonstrations, teleoperation, sensor synchronization, dataset design, quality checks, experiment tracking, and repeatable evaluation.
* Experience with cloud GPU infrastructure, distributed training, model serving, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX, or edge-compute optimization.
* Strong experimental judgment. You establish baselines, define success criteria, investigate failure modes, and know the difference between a compelling demonstration and a robust capability.
* Systems thinking: you understand how learned models must work alongside perception, planning, controls, safety mechanisms, and real-time robot software.
* Ability to work constructively with experienced engineers across disciplines, share technical judgment clearly, and improve work through code review, mentoring, and collaborative problem-solving.
* Grit, intellectual honesty, and willingness to spend substantial time with physical robots when results do not match expectations.
* Willingness to work full-time on-site in Hyderabad.
* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in a relevant technical field—or equivalent demonstrated experience.

**Nice to Have**

These are useful, not mandatory. Please apply if your core experience fits the role.

* Experience with dual-arm manipulation, humanoid robots, dexterous end-effectors, industrial assembly.
* Experience building teleoperation tools, operator interfaces, intervention workflows, or large-scale robot-data pipelines.
* Research publications, open-source contributions, or deployed systems in robotics, embodied AI, computer vision, or controls.
* Experience mentoring engineers or helping establish sound research-engineering practices in a growing team.
* Familiarity with industrial automation, manufacturing workflows, or customer-facing robotics deployments.

**How We Work**

At Perceptyne, the robot is the referee.

A paper result, a benchmark score, a training curve, or an impressive video is more valuable when it helps a real robot perform a useful task reliably. We value first-principles thinking, rapid experimentation, disciplined measurement, and direct observation of what happens on hardware.

We hold a few deliberate tensions:

* Frontier AI, grounded in real robot and customer constraints.
* Fast experimentation, supported by rigorous evaluation and reproducible engineering.
* Learned intelligence where it helps, and classical perception, planning, control, or deterministic logic where it works better.
* Long-term research ambition, connected to near-term useful capabilities.
* Technical depth, combined with clear communication and practical cross-functional collaboration.

We value
**grit and dedication.**
When a policy fails on a real connector, a model is unstable outside its training distribution, a camera-calibration issue invalidates a dataset, or an elegant idea does not survive real-time deployment, you do not merely tune until the demo looks better. You identify the failure mode, establish the right baseline, improve the data or system, update the architecture where necessary, and stay with the problem until there is a credible path forward.

You will thrive here if you want to build the intelligence layer behind robots that do real work—and are excited by the difficult, rewarding path from a promising model to a dependable machine.

title: Applied Scientist II, Amazon Business - External Integrations
description:
**Description**
Amazon Business System Integrations connects Amazon Business with millions of business users and thousands of partner procurement, ERP, and finance systems. We build the APIs, protocols, and agentic experiences that let customers buy on Amazon Business directly from the systems they already use. As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will own and advance the ML and GenAI capabilities that make these integrations smarter, faster, and more reliable. You will drive model accuracy, scientific innovation, and global scale across external systems integrations.
  
  
Our work includes API-based and protocol-based shopping, such as punchout and emerging agent protocols, along with agentic interactions where buyers and AI agents search, compare, and purchase through natural language. It also covers partner onboarding and integration automation, mapping and normalizing catalog, product, and order data across many partner formats, and evaluation frameworks that measure the quality, accuracy, and latency of our agents.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an Applied Scientist on this team, you will work across three dimensions: Invent, Implement, and Influence.
  
  
Invent: You bring deep domain knowledge and fluency with state-of-the-art scientific approaches and emerging research. You practice customer-obsessed science, working backwards from the needs of business buyers, procurement teams, and integration partners to extend or invent new ML approaches, even when no textbook solution exists. You design novel ML and LLM-based methods for agentic shopping, product search and matching, schema and data mapping across partner systems, and automated evaluation of agent quality. You help define the research agenda for our agentic and protocol-based capabilities, and you lead the scientific strategy for accurate, low-latency responses in conversational and API-driven procurement. You author or co-author articles for internal or external peer-reviewed venues when appropriate and not precluded by business considerations.
  
  
Implement: The ML components you develop are integrated directly into production systems serving Amazon Business customers and partners worldwide. You make sound tradeoffs between accuracy and latency, innovation and stability, and short-term and long-term solutions, favoring reuse and established frameworks where appropriate. You make progress semi-autonomously with only occasional guidance, implement at the right level of complexity the first time, and evaluate emerging technologies, including LLMs and GenAI frameworks, largely on your own. You ensure your models and pipelines integrate robustly with catalog, offer, cart, order, and partner data sources and with the services that power external integrations.
  
  
Influence: You contribute to planning for the team, including goals, priorities, and roadmaps for ML and GenAI capabilities. You lead the scientific strategy for expanding agentic and integration capabilities across new partners, protocols, and countries. You collaborate with engineering, product, and program teams across Amazon Business so that data integration and ML pipelines are robust and scale with adoption. You mentor scientists and engineers, champion best practices for the AI-Driven Development Life Cycle (AIDLC), and provide peer feedback on research methods and results. You help recruit bar-raising talent through interview drives, and you are visible in the broader scientific community as a subject matter expert, including serving as a Program Committee member or reviewer for peer-reviewed venues.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
* Master's degree, or PhD

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Executive Manager - AI Platform and Observability
description:
**Overview**
The Executive Manager AI Observability is a seasoned individual contributor who partners alongside Jr. AI Observability Architects to deliver high-quality, production-grade observability capabilities across the enterprise AI platform. This role brings deeper technical experience and greater independent execution capability— owning delivery across one or two specialization tracks with reduced need for day-to-day direction — while working as a genuine peer within the team rather than in a supervisory or mentorship capacity.
  
  
The Executive Manager is expected to be a strong, self-sufficient technical contributor who can take a complex observability requirement from design through implementation and into production operation within their assigned tracks. They bring cross-track awareness that helps the team as a whole, contribute to engineering standard discussions, and collaborate with peer architects on solving shared technical challenges — all without requiring supervisory authority.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Observability Platform Engineering & OTEL Integration (25%)
* Design and implement OpenTelemetry (OTEL) instrumentation within one or two assigned agent frameworks or platforms — including custom exporters, span enrichers, semantic convention tagging, and distributed trace context propagation — with the ability to work independently from requirements through to production deployment.
* Build and maintain telemetry pipeline components (collectors, processors, exporters) that reliably route metrics, logs, traces, and semantic signals to observability backends — owning the full lifecycle of assigned pipeline components including testing, deployment, and on-call support.
* Contribute to the integration of OTEL with enterprise agentic platforms (Salesforce AgentForce, ServiceNow, Microsoft Agent 365, or internal frameworks) within the assigned scope — implementing instrumentation to architecture patterns established by the L11.
* Develop and maintain observability dashboards, alerting rules, and SLO/SLA definitions for assigned sub-domains — validating signal quality and tuning alert thresholds to achieve low false-positive rates.
* Participate in on-call rotations and production incident response — contributing to RCA documentation, runbook authoring, and post-incident improvement actions.
* Write comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for all telemetry components owned; maintain >80% test coverage across assigned services and proactively identify gaps in existing coverage.
* Safety, Security & Red Teaming Observability (15%)
* Implement safety-critical signal capture within assigned telemetry pipelines — building reliable instrumentation for guardrail trigger rates, policy violation events, adversarial detection flags, hallucination indicators, and trust boundary crossing alerts.
* Build observability components that support red team exercises — instrumenting assigned agent systems to capture adversarial test events, behavioral deviations, and attack surface signals in a measurable, repeatable way.
* Implement secure trace handling patterns within assigned pipelines — applying data masking, PII redaction, and audit-log retention configurations as specified by the security architecture.
* Contribute to the Security Observability Playbook — documenting assigned instrumentation patterns, updating escalation procedures based on observed incidents, and maintaining accuracy of the playbook sections within scope.

title: Threat Detection Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
11
  
  
**The Team**
The Cyber Fusion Center protects the business by combining threat intelligence, monitoring, detection engineering, incident response, and security automation into one proactive, intelligence-led defense capability. By breaking down silos, the team reduces risk and strengthens security across the enterprise.
  
  
The team prioritizes collaboration, continuous learning, and innovation, with shared ownership of outcomes and a supportive learning mindset during high-pressure situations. This is a hands-on, build-driven environment where team members work with real-world use cases, rapidly develop new capabilities, and continuously improve the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to emerging threats.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality detections for threats including malware, ransomware, identity attacks, insider threats, cloud threats, network, AI, and advanced persistent threats.

title: AI Infrastructure Engineer – Generative AI Model Serving (Go / Rust / GPU)
description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI
  
  
At Teradata, we’re not just managing data; we’re unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape Analytics™ platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world’s largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale.
  
  
As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation.
* Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust.
* Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use.
* Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama. cpp, and ONNX Runtime; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense.
* Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Own the full delivery path: CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing.
* Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve.
* Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation.
* Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation.

Who You’ll Work With
  
  
You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You’ll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions.
  
  
What Makes You a Qualified Candidate
  
  

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure.
* Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning).
* Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference.
* Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above.
* Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling.
* Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes.
* Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).
* Full-stack engineering experience: comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration.
* Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads.
* You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed.
* You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them.

What You Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale.
* Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating.
* Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus.

Bonus Points
  
  

* Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines.
* Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama. cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment.
* Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents).
* Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices.
* Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust.
* Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

You'll build on top of Saras IQ Product to own the solution and the build for a client requirement - from the first requirements conversation and live customer demos to validated data, one trusted set of metrics, live dashboards, and clean data every morning - as the accountable owner of what gets built as a repeatable product capability.

**About Saras Analytics**

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and Saras IQ) as the data infrastructure in every engagement.

**Why Now**

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. AI-assisted tooling now lets one engineer take a client from the first requirements conversation to a live, trusted dashboard without waiting on a queue of hand-offs. The Forward Deployed Engineer role is built around that: one owner, end to end, with the tooling to make it fast. Because you build on top of our products rather than around them, what you create for one client requirement becomes capability that every client can use. An FDE joining now helps define what that role looks like at its best.

**The Role**

You'll own the solution and the build for one client account, reporting to an FDE Lead. You build on top of our product, Saras IQ, extending it with software you design and code. You are responsible for interacting directly with the customer — running discovery, demoing what you build, and presenting it to client stakeholders — as well as with the product teams, and you contribute to the product roadmap. Whatever you build, you then become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product: you create repeatable solutions that expand what the product can do and maximize revenue impact. On that account you work alongside a Strategic Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and the commercial outcomes, and a Product Manager, who owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it. You own what gets built and whether it is right — requirements, software, data, metrics, dashboards, and data quality — with our AI-assisted tooling and our SME leads behind you for the hardest problems.

**The Bar**

Speed & Delivery quality are the top priorities for this role: what you ship is correct, validated against the source of truth before the client sees it, and there on the date you committed to. Speed matters because clients feel it — the shortest path from signed-off requirements to a live, trusted dashboard — but never at the cost of numbers the client can rely on. You build to product standard: what you write is well designed, tested, version-controlled, and reusable, because it is part of the product. You surface risks before they block delivery, and you close every issue with a root cause and a fix, you internally escalate the dependencies on time. The lanes are explicit: you own the solution and the build; the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial outcomes; the Product Manager owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Own discovery and requirements.**
Join the sales handover to close open questions and call out risks early. Run discovery sessions directly with client stakeholders on the client's core use cases — sales and marketing, contribution margin, customer cohorts, product and inventory — co-design the solution with them, and write the business requirements and metric definitions using Saras' standard templates, reviewing them internally before client sign-off. Build the mock-ups that let clients react before anything is built, demo working builds live to the client at every milestone and take their feedback directly, write the test cases every requirement will be validated against, and track change requests so scope stays visible to you and the Account Manager.

**2. Own the data build.**
Set up integrations and access with our data-ingestion team, translate requirements into technical specifications, and build the staging, master, and presentation datasets with Saras' AI-assisted data-engineering tools, following our data-model conventions (dbt, BigQuery, Git). Apply PII masking, and keep the data dictionary and lineage documentation current. When a problem goes beyond your account — a complex architecture choice or a platform limit — take it to the senior data-engineering lead with a proposed workaround, and keep ownership of the outcome.

**3. Build on top of the product, end to end.**
You are not only modelling data: you build complete solutions on top of Saras IQ, and that takes software & data engineering & Analytics skills. Design and code the services, APIs, integrations, automation, and application logic around the data layer, and apply sound engineering practice — modular design, code review, automated tests, version control, and CI/CD. Write code that others can maintain and extend, because it may become part of the product.

**4. Turn what you build into product.**
Whatever you build, you become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product. Package it as a repeatable, configurable solution rather than a one-off, document it, and help other FDEs and accounts adopt it, so each engagement expands what the product can do and maximizes its revenue impact.

**5. Own the client's metric definitions.**
Configure one certified set of metrics and dimensions for each client in Saras IQ's semantic layer, so that every dashboard, self-serve question, and AI answer draws on the same definitions.

**6. Own validation before anything reaches the client**
. Reconcile every dataset against its source of truth, certify it, and run the internal sign-off against agreed criteria for sending work back. Set up the data quality and completeness checks, validate against the requirement test cases and against a benchmark set of business questions the AI analyst must answer correctly, then walk the Account Manager through the build in a final review before it goes to the client.

**7. Own the consumption layer.**
Build dashboards natively in Saras IQ (and in Tableau, Luzmo, or Power BI where the contract specifies), drawing their metrics from the client's certified definitions. Build and maintain the business context that powers Saras IQ Analyst, our AI analyst; set it up and provision it for client users in Slack and their AI tools; and keep refining that context from what users ask it. The Account Manager leads the launch and adoption, and the Product Manager leads enablement.

**8. Own data quality every day.**
Run the daily data-quality cycle: confirm the overnight pipelines and checks have completed, resolve what they flag, escalate anything still open — or late upstream data — to the senior data-engineering lead, re-run and re-test what you fixed, and send the client a routine data-quality status (with any help you need from them), copying the Account Manager. Configure latency and dashboard alerts, and close every bug and change request with a root cause and a fix. When an issue breaches its SLA or stays open past a day, the Account Manager takes the client escalation and you drive the fix.

**9. Run your delivery hygiene.**
Keep your onboarding and project documentation, task tracker, and timesheets current, so anyone can see where your account stands.

**10. Partner across the lanes.**
Be the direct technical voice to customers and to the product teams, and contribute to the product roadmap. Support your Account Manager with the technical answers behind success criteria, client acceptance testing, and adoption, and demo what you built and walk client users through its logic yourself, while the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial conversations; work with the Product Manager and the product teams to turn what you hear from customers and learn from your builds into roadmap priorities; and work with our data-ingestion and data-engineering teams to unblock ingestion, data quality, and architecture issues.

**What Winning Looks Like**

**First 90 days:**

you know your account's data and metric definitions in depth, you run the daily data-quality cycle reliably, and you've taken at least one deliverable from signed-off requirements to a validated, live dashboard on your own, demoing it to the client yourself.

**Steady state:**

you deliver datasets and dashboards independently and on the committed date, your validation catches issues before clients ever do, your client's mornings start with clean data, your FDE Lead trusts what you ship without re-checking every number, your teammates enjoy working with you, what you've built is reusable and part of the product, you contribute to the roadmap, and you're ready to own a new account launch end to end.

**Who Thrives Here**

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you bring 3+ years (typically 3–6) of hands-on data and software work — some of it building in SQL and code, and some of it facing clients, including demos.

• You've been a business or data analyst who wrote requirements and specifications, worked hands-on in SQL, and are ready to own the build as well as the brief.

• You've been an analytics or data engineer who built layered data models — raw, staging, masters, presentation — and are ready to own the client conversation as well as the pipeline.

• You've delivered data or BI projects in an analytics consulting or services firm, end to end, directly with clients.

• You've been a software engineer who built backend or full-stack applications and data-heavy products, and are ready to take on analytics, data modelling, and the client conversation.

**Whichever route you come from, you have:**

• A degree from a reputed engineering college.

• Strong SQL and data-modelling fundamentals across the raw → staging → master → presentation layers.

• Software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in Python (or a comparable language such as Java, TypeScript, or Go), data structures, and the ability to write clean, modular, tested, maintainable code.

• Software design skills: you can design the architecture of an end-to-end solution — services, APIs, data flows, and integrations — weigh the trade-offs, and build it to be reusable and extensible.

• Engineering practice: code review, unit and integration testing, CI/CD, and debugging in production. • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool — Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

• A foundational understanding of statistics — enough to know when a number is meaningful and when it isn't.

• Working knowledge of dbt and BigQuery (or the ability to ramp up quickly), and everyday use of Git.

• Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot — we'll train you on Saras' own tooling.

• The ability to turn an ambiguous client ask into clear, testable requirements and a technical specification.

• Clear, confident client communication — you can own a delivery conversation without a go-between, run live product demos, and present to client and product stakeholders.

• The ability to work with product teams and contribute to a roadmap: you can turn customer needs and what you've built into reusable product capabilities.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

• An engineering degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Analytics, or Data Science.

• Ecommerce data fluency: you know how contribution margin, customer cohorts, attribution, and inventory are really calculated — and where the source data misleads.

• Experience with a semantic or metrics layer, or with data-quality and observability frameworks.

• Dashboards you've built that clients actually use, and the instinct for what makes one trustworthy.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience building APIs, integrations, or full-stack applications, and with cloud services (GCP preferred) and containerization.

• You've presented analysis directly to a client or senior stakeholder, not just to your own team.

**Location**

Hyderabad. Standard working hours are noon to 9 PM IST.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, comprehensive health insurance, relocation support, and ongoing professional development. Saras Analytics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace for all. If you want to own what gets built, end to end, on top of our product, and see it land with the client, then make it part of the product, we want to talk to you.

**The Opportunity**

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.

We are looking for Software Engineers (SE) who can break down and solve complex problems with a strong motivation to get things done with a boots-on-the-ground, pragmatic mindset! Our engineers own their products end to end and influence the way how our products and technology are deployed to facilitate most aspects of drug discovery impacting hundreds of thousands of patients around the world. We are looking for engineers who can creatively handle complex dependencies and ambiguous requirements, competing business priorities, while producing fit-for-purpose, optimal solutions.
  
  
We are hoping that you are passionate about collaborating across the interface between hard-core software development and research and discovery data analysis.
  
  
Our Engineering team builds core components used by our company's Research Labs’ data analytics, visualization, and management workflows. The analysis tools and pipelines built for data processing by our team in partnership with our scientists aim to accelerate research and the discovery of new therapies for our patients.
  
  
We collect, annotate, analyze petabytes of scientific data (multi-omics, chemistry, imaging, safety) used in biomarker research, drug safety/efficacy, drug target discovery, and compendium diagnostic development. We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. title: AI Platform Applications Engineer/Associate Director
description:
**Ready to scale enterprise Generative AI products from prototype to production?**
**Why join us?**
HSBC Productivity Suite is our AI-powered workspace used by 250,000 colleagues across the bank. We’re moving beyond conversational generative AI to build intelligent agents and integrations that connect colleagues with trusted enterprise knowledge, services and workflows.
  
  
You’ll join a global engineering team solving complex problems at significant scale. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how artificial intelligence is designed, governed and used across HSBC, with real influence over architecture, engineering standards and product direction.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Our team consists of around 50 engineers across the UK, India, Poland and China. We’re growing our engineering capability in China and are looking for an experienced engineer to work as a senior technical contributor within one of our engineering pods.
  
  
As an Associate Director, Software Engineering, you’ll operate as an individual contributor, designing and delivering significant capabilities for HSBC Productivity Suite. You’ll take complex requirements from initial definition through coding, testing, release and production operation.
  
  
This is not a formal people-management role. You’ll spend most of your time on hands-on engineering while providing practical technical direction, removing delivery blockers and mentoring other engineers in the pod.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
This role will carry out the following activities:
  
  

* 10+years of Min experience.
* Spend most of your time on hands-on engineering, writing, reviewing, testing and shipping production code for HSBC Productivity Suite.
* Design and deliver significant generative AI capabilities and integrations, owning delivery from requirements through to production operation.
* Act as a senior engineer within an engineering pod, making sound design decisions, clarifying ambiguity and breaking complex requirements into actionable deliveries.
* Build secure, resilient and maintainable services, applying appropriate engineering controls across testing, deployment, monitoring, observability and production support.
* Use and improve shared frameworks, platforms and reusable capabilities, giving constructive feedback and reducing duplication and technical debt.
* Promote effective engineering practices, including the safe use of AI coding tools and agents to improve quality and delivery across the software development lifecycle.
* Take an active role in production incidents, helping restore service, leading reviews and ensuring lessons result in practical improvements.
* Mentor engineers through pairing, design and code reviews, knowledge-sharing and practical support, while informing technical direction through evidence and engineering expertise.

**What you’ll need to succeed in the role**
:
  
  

* Strong hands-on software engineering experience, with a record of designing, coding, testing and operating significant applications or product capabilities.
* Effective use of AI coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, to prototype, write, test and review code safely, with an interest in building agents that improve the software development lifecycle.
* Strong Python expertise and practical knowledge of modern engineering practices, including application programming interfaces, microservices, databases, containers, automated testing and continuous integration and delivery.
* Hands-on experience building AI, machine learning or generative AI solutions and taking them from experimentation into secure, reliable production use.
* Practical knowledge of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, evaluation, guardrails, observability and responsible AI.
* Sound engineering judgement across performance, security, resilience, maintainability, accessibility, technical debt and production operability.
* Ability to clarify ambiguous requirements, identify the most important parts of a problem and deliver robust solutions with limited oversight.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly, challenge constructively and mentor engineers in a global team.

**Building HSBC’s AI engineering capability**
This is a chance to shape how enterprise AI engineering is built and scaled across HSBC. You’ll create the platforms, patterns and delivery discipline that help teams move from experimentation to production with confidence. The work spans technology and business outcomes with clear accountability for quality, reliability and measurable value. If you’re ready to help set direction for GenAI at enterprise scale we’d welcome your application.
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Applied AI Analyst II
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
The Applied AI Analyst II, Enabling Functions will help evolve Enabling Functions Analytics from static reporting toward intelligent, conversational, and reusable analytics products. The role combines practical AI research, context engineering, semantic modelling, and hands-on prototyping to connect governed enterprise data with large language models and modern analytics platforms. The individual will investigate how LLMs process context and generate responses, translate those learnings into reliable solution patterns, and build AI-enabled experiences using Claude, Databricks, Power BI, and related technologies. The role includes building text-to-SQL workflows, tool-using agents, and multi-agent systems that answer business questions reliably and transparently
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Apply working knowledge of concepts and procedures to a variety of analytics and AI assignments, using judgement to solve problems with a moderate level of guidance.
* Own well-defined research, experimentation, and prototyping workstreams, documenting assumptions, decisions, results, and limitations.
* Research and test LLM behaviours, reasoning patterns, context-window usage, tool use, structured outputs, and failure modes, and convert findings into practical design guidance and reusable patterns for analytics use cases.
* Design and optimise system instructions, business context, examples, metadata, retrieval strategies, and tool interfaces so AI responses are grounded, relevant, and consistent. Manage context quality, freshness, and token efficiency.
* Build text-to-SQL workflows that translate natural-language questions into governed queries, grounded in certified semantic models and metric definitions, with validation steps that check generated SQL before execution.
* Design tool-using agents that call approved functions and data services (such as SQL execution, metric lookup, and visualization generation) with clearly defined tool schemas, permissions, and fallback behaviour.
* Design and prototype multi-agent workflows in which specialist agents (for example, query planning, SQL generation, validation, and insight narration) coordinate under an orchestrator, with clear handoffs, state management, and loop and cost limits.
* Prototype chat-with-data and chat-with-document experiences that let users explore governed business information in natural language, while preserving traceability to approved data and metric definitions.
* Design and improve business-ready semantic models covering grain, dimensions, measures, relationships, hierarchies, synonyms, descriptions, and certified definitions, ensuring the same logic supports Power BI, Databricks, and AI experiences.
* Evaluate when to use prompting, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling, multi-agent workflows, or traditional analytics, and define fit-for-purpose architectures rather than applying LLMs where deterministic methods are more appropriate.
* Create test cases and evaluation datasets for SQL accuracy, tool-call correctness, agent task completion, groundedness, latency, and cost. Investigate hallucinations, retrieval or semantic failures, and agent loops, and recommend corrective actions.
* Build proof-of-value solutions using Python, SQL, APIs, Claude, and Databricks, integrating AI capabilities with existing analytics assets and, where appropriate, Power BI or lightweight application experiences.
* Break ambiguous business questions into clear problem statements, hypotheses, data needs, and solution options. Rapidly learn unfamiliar domains and communicate trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Document patterns, reusable components, guardrails, and lessons learned, and contribute to internal standards for context engineering, semantic models, LLM evaluation, and responsible AI adoption.
* Partner with business analysts, BI developers, data engineers, AI/ML specialists, architects, and governance teams to move successful prototypes toward sustainable products.
* Balance innovation with responsible AI, data governance, security, privacy, quality, and production-readiness expectations, including human-in-the-loop controls for consequential actions.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and structured problem-solving, including comfort with ambiguous questions and incomplete information.
* Practical understanding of how large language models work, including tokenisation, embeddings, attention, context windows, inference, common failure modes, and the difference between model knowledge and supplied context.
* Hands-on expertise in prompt and context engineering, including instruction design, few-shot examples, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, tool use, and context optimisation.
* Strong SQL workflow skills: writing and reviewing complex queries, designing text-to-SQL pipelines, enforcing read-only access and query guardrails, validating generated SQL against schema and metric definitions, and diagnosing incorrect joins, grain mismatches, and aggregation errors.
* Experience designing tool-using agents, including function and tool schema design, argument validation, error handling, retries, and permission boundaries.
* Working knowledge of multi-agent architectures such as orchestrator-worker, planner-executor, and specialist-agent patterns, including state management, handoffs between agents, termination conditions, and observability across agent steps.
* Hands-on experience with Anthropic Claude or comparable enterprise LLM platforms, including API-based integration, prompt orchestration, tool calling, and solution evaluation.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks, including notebooks, SQL Warehouses, governed data assets, and lakehouse-based analytics workflows. Exposure to Unity Catalog, AI/BI Genie, MLflow, or Mosaic AI is valuable.
* Experience designing and integrating REST APIs or equivalent service interfaces to connect LLMs, enterprise data platforms, and application experiences.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL for data exploration, AI prototyping, integration, evaluation, and automation.
* Experience with Git-based source control, branching, and pull-request practices, together with CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment
* Hands-on understanding of AWS deployment patterns for AI and analytics solutions, including environment configuration, security, logging, monitoring, and release processes is a plus
* Experience designing or consuming semantic models, with strong understanding of business metrics, dimensional modelling, relationships, grain, hierarchies, synonyms, and reusable business definitions.
* Experience with vector search, agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol, LLM observability, or automated evaluation methods.
* Ability to design experiments and evaluation datasets and assess groundedness, relevance, consistency, completeness, latency, and cost.
* Ability to present complex information to non-technical stakeholders in a clear and concise manner, and to create relevant and engaging PowerPoint presentations.
* Awareness of responsible AI, privacy, cybersecurity, data governance, access control, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical AI concepts into practical business implications and document reusable engineering patterns.
* Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

**Good to Have**

* Practical machine learning knowledge, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and basic MLOps.
* Experience with Power BI, including semantic models, DAX, Power Query, row-level security, and integration of BI assets with AI-enabled analytics experiences.
* Familiarity with React or lightweight full-stack application development for creating user-facing AI experiences.
* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks and production monitoring of multi-agent systems.
* Experience working in regulated or highly governed enterprise environments.

**Experience**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering
* Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in analytics, data science, AI engineering, software engineering, or a closely related field. Strong applied project work may substitute for some formal experience.
* Demonstrated experience solving analytical problems using Python and SQL, including building or reviewing text-to-SQL or query-generation workflows.
* Demonstrated hands-on delivery involving Claude or a comparable LLM, tool-using agents or multi-agent workflows, Databricks, APIs, Git/CI/CD, and deployment of an AI-enabled analytics prototype.
* Experience working with stakeholders to translate a business question into a testable analytical or AI solution.
* Experience producing clear technical documentation and communicating analytical results using compelling oral and written storytelling.
* Ability to handle, and maintain the confidentiality of, highly sensitive information.

description:
**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**
At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.
  
  
Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.
  
  
**Sr AI/ML Compiler Engineer**
**The Role**
AMD is looking for an influential software engineer role to enable AI acceleration at scale. You will be a member of the core team, working on developing ML tools and methodologies to optimize and realize full system performance for AI workloads on Ryzen AI SoC. Working on the latest AI models addressing vision, language, and generative models, working with the leading engineers in AMD’s CPU, GPU, and Adaptable Compute team
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the development and maintenance of AMD's AI compilers, and runtime.
* Consistently research and implement methods to improve performance of our solutions.
* Stay informed of software and hardware trends and innovations, especially pertaining to ML algorithms and architectures.
* Optimizing current system and research alternative, more efficient ways for same goals.
* Develop technical relationships with peers and partners.
* Work with AMD’s architecture specialists to improve future products.

* Strong object-oriented programming background, C/C++ preferred with 6+ years of industry experience
* Good understanding of object-oriented design principles
* Good understanding of Software Engineering principles, Data structure, algorithms, Operating Systems concepts and multithread programming
* Ability to write high quality code with a keen attention to detail.
* Knowledge of AI frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNXRuntime, TVM, MLIR

title: Technical Lead / Engineering Lead – Hands-On
description:
**Technical Lead / Engineering Lead – Hands-On**

**Company: Template.net**

**Location: Hyderabad, India**

**Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**About Template.net**

Template.net is an AI-native creation platform used by more than 4 million people worldwide every month.

We are building the next generation of AI-powered creation tools, where users simply describe what they need, and AI turns their ideas into finished, editable designs, videos, and documents—all in one place, from prompt to ready-to-use content in minutes.

We are a global product and technology company building scalable, high-performance AI products for users worldwide.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a hands-on Technical Lead / Engineering Lead who can own engineering end-to-end—from system architecture and writing production code to deployment, scaling, and production reliability.

This is not a management-only role. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys coding, solving complex technical challenges, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building high-performing engineering teams.

You'll work closely with Product to build, launch, and scale AI-powered applications used by millions of people worldwide.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end engineering: Lead system architecture, technical design, development, deployment, scaling, and production operations.
* Stay hands-on with coding: Actively write, review, debug, and ship production code while guiding the engineering team.
* Design scalable systems: Build reliable, high-performance applications using modern backend architectures, databases, APIs, caching, queues, and asynchronous processing.
* Build AI-powered products: Integrate LLMs, generative AI models, APIs, and image, video, and audio generation workflows.
* Optimize AI infrastructure: Improve inference latency, processing performance, model integration reliability, and API costs.
* Own production reliability: Drive CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, security, performance optimization, and incident resolution.
* Accelerate engineering delivery: Leverage AI-assisted coding tools, automation, and modern development practices to ship high-quality software faster.
* Build and mentor the team: Hire, develop, and lead engineers while establishing strong engineering standards and a culture of ownership.
* Ship products quickly: Collaborate closely with Product to turn ideas into working software, launch features rapidly, and continuously improve them.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with proven hands-on coding skills and technical leadership.
* Engineer first, leader second: Someone who enjoys writing code, solving complex technical problems, and leading by example—not just managing people.
* Strong backend or full-stack expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, SQL, or comparable technologies.
* Deep understanding of system architecture, distributed systems, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and scalable application design.
* End-to-end product engineering experience: Proven ability to independently design, build, deploy, scale, and troubleshoot production applications.
* Practical AI/GenAI experience: Experience integrating LLM APIs and building AI-powered applications. Exposure to image, video, or audio generation is an advantage.
* Strong production engineering skills in performance optimization, security, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and reliability.
* Experience leading and mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, making architectural decisions, and building high-performing teams.
* AI-first development mindset: Comfortable using AI coding tools, automation, and modern engineering workflows to accelerate development.
* Strong ownership and product thinking: Able to make pragmatic technical decisions, move quickly, avoid unnecessary complexity, and deliver reliable products that create real customer value.

**Why Join Template.net?**

* Build cutting-edge AI products used by millions of people worldwide.
* Work on challenging engineering problems across generative AI, image, video, documents, and design.
* Take real ownership of technical architecture, engineering decisions, and product delivery.
* Build and lead a talented engineering team while continuing to write production code.
* Work in a fast-moving, product-focused environment where your contributions have a direct impact.

* We're looking for a builder who leads by example—someone who can take a problem, design the solution, write the code, ship it to production

title: Technical Team Lead – Applied & Agentic AI Systems
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning.
  
  
In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad.
  
  
**Description Of The Area**
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
  
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e.g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). This team will not only build end-to-end solutions, but also support "buy and integrate" projects while gathering technical feedback to support the ongoing development of RDT AI Platforms.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Team Management**

* Manage multi-disciplinary team members with different skill sets from your own, injecting stability into the squad within a complex organizational environment
* Cultivate healthy team dynamics, collaboration, psychological safety, and open communication while maintaining a sustainable pace of work
* Set clear focus and priorities for the team's delivery work, managing sprint goals in partnership with Product Managers while actively removing roadblocks. Engage in continuous product discovery in partnership with Product Managers and UX leads. Be willing and able to step into a Product Owner role when necessary.
* Explain the "WHY" and provide necessary context to your team members

**Capability Development & Resource Management:**

* Encourage team members to self-define and drive their career journey and actively enable development opportunities that align with it
* Manage hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, compensation calibration, succession planning, handling underperformance, and conflict resolution
* Manage the team's budget, including headcount, software/infrastructure operational costs, and vendor contracts, ensuring financial responsibility

**Technical Direction & Architecture:**

* Enable technical decision-making and design of robust, resilient, and highly available systems that integrate generative AI, multi-agent frameworks, RAG/GraphRAG pipelines, state machines, classical ML, and enterprise data ecosystems
* Establish robust patterns for utilizing LLMs, multimodal foundation models, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, and vector, graph and relational databases
* Ensure newly developed AI applications fit within the context of RDT and Business functions, strictly following architectural patterns, standards, and data strategies established across the functions
* Identify areas of technical debt and perform pragmatic cost/benefit analyses for resolving this debt, ensuring optimal cloud resource and model inference cost-efficiency
* Establish and enforce rigorous enterprise standards for code, systems development, identity management, and authentication mechanisms across the team

**Agentic SDLC & Code Quality:**

* Ensure the team effectively leverages agentic Software Development Lifecycle workflows and tools daily (e.g., Claude Code, autonomous agents) to safely accelerate development and automated testing cycles
* Act as the technical standards keeper; perform or enable effective, rigorous code reviews for both human-written and AI-generated code to maintain strict enterprise software engineering standards

**Compliance & Regulatory Alignment:**

* Oversee compliance-by-design strategies for AI deployments, ensuring engineering deliverables are audit-ready and aligned with GxP compliance and Computerized System Validation (CSV)/Software Assurance (CSA) standards
* Enforce strict data integrity controls (ALCOA+) to preserve validated infrastructure states

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor or advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology, Science, or a related field
* Leadership Experience: 3+ years of experience in team leadership and people leadership in an agile product delivery environment, with a proven track record of building and leading high-performing teams
* Technical Experience: 7+ years of experience working in AI software development teams, with at least 5 years as a hands-on engineer or architect designing cloud-native solutions
* Regulated Domain Experience: Proven experience operating within a highly regulated environment (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical healthcare preferred) delivering validated applications
* Exhibits servant and creative leadership (VACC) behavior
* Possesses deep active listening and mentoring/coaching skills
* Demonstrates a leadership presence, strong business acumen, ability to navigate ambiguity, and manage complexity
* Is a decisive leader, comfortable making decisions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Brings an enterprise mindset that can break down silos, focusing on delivery through collaboration across organizational boundaries

**Technical Skills**

* AI & Orchestration Frameworks: Deep practical expertise in multi-agent system design, state machine logic, and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph
* Classical Machine Learning: strong hands-on background in building applications driven by classical (pre-generative) Machine Learning and MLOps
* Core Programming: Production-grade mastery in advanced Python for backend/AI workloads and TypeScript for modern frontend interfaces and generative AI and classical ML UX/UI. Strong foundational understanding of modern full-stack development environments
* Data & Cloud Platforms: Strong architectural understanding of enterprise data platforms like Snowflake, vector databases (e.g., AWS OpenSearch), and graph databases (e.g., AWS Neptune)
* Cloud Engineering & DevOps: High proficiency overseeing AWS cloud architecture (including serverless workloads, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, etc.), managing fully automated CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker), and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
* AI Observability: Experience defining monitoring, logging, and telemetry strategies to track model drift, API/MCP health, resource utilization, and anomaly identification

**Additional Qualifications**

* Excels in communicating in English highly effectively and clearly, at the level of: C1+
* Strong stakeholder management skills to influence non-technical Senior Stakeholders on complex architectural designs
* Be passionate about AI, staying up-to-date with the latest developments in LLMs, GenAI, agentic, classical ML, cloud computing, and software architectures
* Be team-oriented, proactive, and collaborative , with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Be an excellent problem solver and analytical thinker, detail-oriented and highly organized
* Be willing to learn and expand their skill set in an environment where roles are fluid and multidisciplinary

Located in Hyderabad, India, with working hours structured to capture the 'golden hours' of overlap with Central European Time (typically running through the IST evening).
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: AI-Native Systems Builder

We're looking for builders.
  
  
Not product managers. Not software engineers. Not AI researchers. People who happen to do all three when the problem demands it — because they care more about solving the problem than about which lane it falls in.
  
  
****What this role is****
Darwinbox is an enterprise HCM platform used by hundreds of large organizations across multiple countries. We're in the middle of a fundamental shift — rearchitecting the product and the company to be AI-native. Not adding AI features to an existing system. Rebuilding how the system thinks, operates, and delivers value.
  
  
This role exists because the most important work in that transformation doesn't fit traditional job boundaries. It sits at the intersection of product thinking, systems engineering, enterprise domain knowledge, and AI — and it requires people who can hold all of that in their head while shipping something that actually works.
  
  
You will take ambiguous, high-stakes enterprise problems and turn them into working systems. Some will be customer-facing product capabilities. Some will be internal operational systems. All of them will require you to think deeply about the realities of enterprise software — permissions, auditability, multi-tenancy, scale, configurability, edge cases — because that's where most "AI-powered" systems quietly break.
  
  
****What the work looks like****
You won't get a detailed spec. You'll get a problem.
  
  
It might sound like: "Our customers can't tell whether their employees are actually using the platform — and neither can we." Or: "Implementation consultants spend 40% of their time on work that should be systematized." Or: "This workflow was designed for humans filling forms — redesign it for a world where AI handles 80% of the steps."
  
  
Your job is to go from that problem statement to a production system. You'll need to understand the business context, design the solution, build it (using AI-native development workflows extensively), validate it against real enterprise complexity, and iterate until it works — not in a demo, but at scale, with real customers, in production.
  
  
****Who thrives here****
People who build things outside of work — not because someone asked, but because they saw a problem and couldn't leave it unsolved.
  
  
People who use AI tools daily and have strong opinions about where they're transformative and where they're dangerous.
  
  
People who think in systems — who instinctively ask "what breaks downstream?" and "what happens at 100x scale?" and "what's the edge case no one mentioned?"
  
  
People who've shipped things. Not prototyped. Shipped. In environments where the user didn't forgive rough edges.
  
  
You might come from engineering, product, consulting, design, operations, or a path that doesn't have a clean label. We genuinely don't care about the label. We care about how you think, how you simplify, and what you've built.
  
  
****What we explicitly don't optimize for****

* Resume pedigree as a proxy for capability
* Interview performance on problems you'd never encounter here
* AI enthusiasm without AI execution
* Coordination-heavy profiles that produce slides instead of systems
* Prototype thinking without production realism

****Why this role exists****
Most companies hire PMs to write specs, engineers to execute them, and analysts to measure the outcome. Three roles, three handoffs, three points of context loss.
  
  
We're building a company where one person can hold the full arc — problem to system to outcome — because we believe that's how the best enterprise software gets built in the AI era.
  
  
If that sounds like how you already think, we should talk.
