title: Principal AI/ML Architect
description:
**About Egen**
:
  
  
Egen is a fast-growing, entrepreneurial technology company with a data-first mindset. We bring together exceptional engineering talent and advanced technology platforms, including Google Cloud and Salesforce, to help clients drive action and impact through data and insights.
  
  
We are committed to being a place where talented people choose to do their best work - applying deep engineering and technology expertise to envision how data, AI, and platforms can change the world for the better. We are dedicated to learning, thrive on solving difficult problems, and continually innovate to achieve fast, effective results. If that describes you, we want you on our team.
  
  
**About the opportunity:**
As a Principal AI/ML Architect, you will set the technical direction for Egen's most complex generative AI, agentic AI, and applied machine learning engagements while remaining personally hands-on in the work that matters most. We treat AI as a software engineering discipline. You will raise that bar by architecting systems that succeed in production and helping the engineers around you do the same.
  
  
You will own the hardest architectural problems in our portfolio: agentic platforms operating at scale, applied-ML solutions, advanced retrieval systems, and AI in regulated or high-stakes environments where being wrong is expensive. Document intelligence and RAG pipelines are part of your toolkit, not the ceiling. You will take systems from an ambiguous business problem to a robust, scalable service, solving for latency, reliability, cost, security, and governance.
  
  
You will also be the senior technical face of our engagements. You will partner directly with client leadership to translate business strategy into AI architecture, shape solutions during pre-sales, guide engineering teams, and earn the trust that turns a project into a long-term program.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Set enterprise AI architecture and technical direction: Own the end-to-end architecture for complex GenAI, agentic AI, and ML platforms. Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering guardrails, and technology choices across engagements.
* Build at the frontier - hands-on: Stay close to the code on the highest-leverage technical work, including foundation-model and embedding fine-tuning, advanced RAG, semantic search, evaluation harnesses, and novel agentic workflows using Python and Google Cloud Vertex AI.
* Engineer AI for production: Design for latency, reliability, security, cost, scalability, and maintainability from day one. Apply disciplined MLOps and LLMOps practices so systems are versioned, evaluated, monitored, deployed, and continuously improved.
* Architect agentic systems at scale: Design and operate multi-step reasoning and multi-agent workflows using ADK, LangChain, MCP, and custom agent frameworks, with robust orchestration, state management, tool use, memory, human oversight, failure isolation, and verification controls.
* Establish evaluation, observability, and responsible AI standards: Define measurable quality criteria and production telemetry for accuracy, groundedness, safety, drift, latency, and cost. Embed privacy, security, governance, and responsible AI throughout the lifecycle.
* Shape data and retrieval architectures: Design production-scale retrieval and knowledge systems spanning data ingestion, chunking, metadata, embeddings, vector and hybrid search, re-ranking, provenance, permissions, and continuous content refresh.
* Advise clients and shape opportunities: Partner with client executives and engineering leaders to translate business strategy into AI roadmaps and solution architectures. Lead discovery, technical workshops, estimates, trade-off discussions, and pre-sales solutioning.
* Multiply engineering capability: Raise the technical bar through architecture reviews, design documents, code reviews, mentoring, reusable accelerators, and clear standards that help senior and mid-level engineers deliver with greater confidence.
* Own outcomes across the full lifecycle: Guide initiatives from problem framing and experimentation through production rollout, operational readiness, adoption, and measurable business value. Surface risks early and drive decisions to resolution.

**Your technical toolkit:**
**Languages and software engineering**
Expert-level Python; strong shell scripting; API and service design; clean, tested, maintainable code; distributed-system fundamentals; and full SDLC ownership.
  
  
**Models and AI ecosystem**
Deep, current expertise with Google Gemini, GPT-class models, LLaMA and other open models; advanced prompt engineering; structured outputs; model selection; fine-tuning; and rigorous evaluation.
  
  
**Agentic AI engineering**
Hands-on production experience with Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LangChain, custom agent frameworks, tool use, Model Context Protocol (MCP), workflow orchestration, planning, memory, state, guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls, and multi-agent design.
  
  
**Retrieval and search**
Advanced RAG, hybrid and semantic search, embeddings, re-ranking, and vector platforms such as Vertex AI Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone, or equivalent technologies.
  
  
**Cloud infrastructure and AI systems**
End-to-end experience architecting highly available, scalable AI and software environments across Google Cloud / Vertex AI, AWS, and Azure, including model serving, data integration, IAM, networking, security, observability, and cost management.
  
  
**Frameworks**
Strong command of LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration layers - together with the judgment to use simpler, more maintainable patterns when appropriate.
  
  
**MLOps and LLMOps**
CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and production incident response.
  
  
**Data and ML foundations**
Strong SQL and data engineering; classical machine learning; neural networks; training, tuning, and inference; and the ability to connect data quality to model and product outcomes.
  
  
**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* 15+ years of progressive experience across software engineering, machine learning, data, or AI, including substantial ownership of production systems at scale.
* Demonstrated principal-level technical leadership, including architecture ownership, cross-team technical direction, and decision-making across complex engagements or product portfolios.
* A proven record of deploying generative AI, agentic AI, and/or applied-ML products into production - beyond proofs of concept.
* Deep hands-on expertise with Python, modern LLM and ML architectures, agent frameworks, Google Cloud / Vertex AI, production APIs, and scalable software systems.
* Experience establishing evaluation, observability, security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls for enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong data engineering and SQL knowledge, with the ability to design reliable data and retrieval foundations for AI products.
* Senior client-facing experience, with the communication skills to explain technical choices, risks, and business value to executive stakeholders and engineering teams.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience training, tuning, or adapting neural networks, embedding models, or foundation models.
* Architecture experience in regulated or high-stakes domains such as healthcare, financial services, or the public sector.
* Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or comparable certification.
* Experience building reusable AI accelerators, reference implementations, or platform capabilities across multiple clients or product teams.
* Pre-sales experience including discovery workshops, solution shaping, estimation, proposal development, and technical presentations.
* Familiarity or good to have understanding with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, event-driven architectures, and modern data platforms.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Agentic AI and Voice Agents
description:
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a senior AI engineer to build and lead agentic AI systems: LLM agents that plan, call tools
  
  
and complete real business tasks end to end. You will build agents that hold live phone and web
  
  
conversations — streaming speech recognition, reasoning and tool calls, and speech synthesis in real
  
  
time. You will stay hands-on while setting technical direction, owning the evaluation system that proves
  
  
each agent works before every release, and helping a team of AI engineers move use cases from a demo
  
  
to a reliable, observable service that clients trust with their customers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agentic systems**

* Design and build LLM agents that plan, call tools and complete multi-step business tasks across

voice, chat and back-office channels.
  
  

* Implement task and conversation state, memory and context management, retrieval (RAG) and

model routing between fast and more capable models.
  
  

* Define tool schemas and permissions, validate every tool call, and add human approval points

for high-impact actions.
  
  

* Build durable workflows with checkpoints, retries, idempotency keys, timeouts and

compensation for failed actions.
  
  

* Use multi-agent designs, such as a router with specialist agents, only where they measurably

beat a single agent.
  
  

* Integrate CRMs, ticketing systems and databases for actions such as complaint registration,

classification, routing, status updates and notifications, with warm human handoff.
  
  
**Voice agents**

* Build streaming pipelines that connect telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) and WebRTC audio to ASR,

LLMs and TTS over WebSockets.
  
  

* Implement voice activity detection, turn detection, barge-in and cancellation so the agent stops

talking the moment a caller speaks.
  
  

* Set and hold latency budgets per hop (ASR, LLM, TTS, network), with a target of under [1 s] from

end of caller speech to first agent audio.
  
  

* Adapt agent behaviour for speech: short turns, confirmations before actions, and recovery from

mishearing.
  
  

* Support multilingual and code-switched calls, including language detection and matching TTS

voices.
  
  
**Evaluation**

* Build and maintain golden test sets that define the user goal, persona, expected tool calls and

pass criteria for each scenario.
  
  

* Run trajectory evals that check each step, tool choice, arguments and order, not just the final

answer.
  
  

* Run simulated-caller evals for voice: an LLM plays the caller, TTS voices it with accents, noise

and interruptions, and the agent is tested end to end over real audio.
  
  

* Score task success, tool-call correctness, policy compliance, hallucination, word error rate and

latency, using rule checks and LLM judges calibrated against human ratings.
  
  

* Gate releases in CI on eval results, block regressions, and turn every confirmed production

failure into a new test case.
  
  
**Backend and operations**

* Write async Python services (FastAPI, asyncio) with structured logging, tracing and metrics for

every agent run and conversation.
  
  

* Load-test concurrent sessions, find bottlenecks and keep p95 latency and per-task model cost

within budget.
  
  

* Protect sensitive data: authentication and authorisation, audit trails for agent actions, PII

redaction and tenant isolation.
  
  

* Ship with Docker and CI using staged releases and rollback, and troubleshoot live agents in

production.
  
  

* Work with product and delivery teams to turn client workflows into working agent integrations.

**Technical leadership**

* Own the architecture of agent and voice systems, document key decisions and explain trade-offs

to engineers, product and clients.
  
  

* Break client requirements into technical designs and delivery milestones, and assign work across

the team.
  
  

* Review code and designs, and set team standards for testing, evaluation, monitoring and

release.
  
  

* Mentor AI engineers through pairing, design reviews and feedback, and help them grow into

owning features end to end.
  
  

* Lead incident response for production issues, run blameless post-mortems and drive the fixes to

completion.
  
  
**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Strong Python and backend skills: APIs, asyncio, WebSockets, structured error handling and

automated tests.
  
  

* Hands-on experience shipping LLM agents beyond a prompt demo: tool calling, state

management, RAG and failure handling in a real workflow.
  
  

* Sound judgement on agent design: when a fixed workflow beats an autonomous agent, single

versus multi-agent, and how to keep agents safe with permissions and guardrails.
  
  

* Working knowledge of a real-time voice stack: streaming ASR and TTS, VAD, turn-taking and the

trade-offs between latency and accuracy.
  
  

* Experience designing evaluations for LLM agents: test sets, trajectory and outcome metrics,

LLM-as-judge and regression tracking — and knowing when a metric is misleading.
  
  

* Ability to debug across services using logs, traces and recorded sessions to find where an agent

failed or slowed down.
  
  

* Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, Git, Docker and CI pipelines.
* Evidence of owning production services from design through operation, including reliability

under real traffic.
  
  

* Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing their work and leading technical decisions with

product or client stakeholders.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with clear examples of

delivered work.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* Agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Temporal or

MCP tool servers.
  
  

* Production voice agents on telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) or WebRTC, with frameworks such as

LiveKit Agents or Pipecat.
  
  

* Speech providers such as Deepgram, Whisper, Google STT, ElevenLabs, Azure TTS or Cartesia,

and measuring their WER and latency on your own data.
  
  

* Indian-language and code-switched speech (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and English).
* Queues, caching and event-driven systems (Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and load-testing tools such

as Locust or k6.
  
  

* Access controls, PII redaction and on-premises or restricted-network deployments.

forms), and combining them with voice or text in one agent.

Success means AI agents — voice, chat or back-office — that complete real business tasks reliably, with
  
  
evidence that they work, and a team that ships them with confidence. In your first six months, that looks
  
  
**Like**

* Business outcomes: agents measurably resolve tasks without human help, cut handling time

and raise customer satisfaction for client use cases.
  
  

* Reliability: workflows recover from timeouts, tool failures and bad input; write actions are

never duplicated; every incident is traced to a cause and fixed.
  
  

* Evaluation culture: every release is gated by evals, metrics track what users actually experience,

and production failures flow back into the test sets.
  
  

* Performance and cost: latency and per-task model cost stay within agreed budgets as traffic

grows.
  
  

* Delivery: client requirements become working integrations on schedule, with clear handover to

product and delivery teams.
  
  

* Engineering quality: features are tested, observable, documented and easy for others to

maintain.
  
  

* Team growth: architecture decisions are documented, engineers you mentor own features end

to end, and the team ships faster with fewer production issues.

You will partner with platform engineering, security, and product teams to define guardrails, measure impact (productivity, quality, and risk), and continuously improve developer experience.This role is strictly involved in development of product and does not involve direct access to Protected Health Information (PHI), Personally Identifiable Information (PII), or any secured or confidential client data. The work is limited to product development and does not include handling or processing of sensitive health or personal information.
  
  
**Your role in our mission**
**GitHub Copilot Enablement & Productization:**
Own and evolve an enterprise-ready Copilot enablement approach: usage patterns, prompt standards, and governance for regulated environments. Create and curate a repository-backed library of reusable prompt files (.github/prompts) for common engineering scenarios (bug fixes, brownfield enhancements from user stories, refactoring, test generation, security remediation).Author and maintain custom instruction files (repository and organization patterns) to enforce coding standards, architecture conventions, error handling, logging, and testing practices.Design interactive ‘guided’ prompts that ask one question at a time, minimize friction for low adopters, and require user confirmation before applying code changes.Collaborate with teams to integrate Copilot into day-to-day workflows in Visual Studio and GitHub (PR templates, checklists, review guidance).
  
  
**Guardrails, Security & Quality:**
Define and implement guardrails so AI-assisted code can’t land without required quality and security signals (tests, reviews, and automated scanning). Establish measurement for AI-assisted development: Copilot usage metrics (suggested vs added LOC, acceptance actions) and repo outcomes (review cycle time, defect inflow proxies, security findings), with clear limitations and directional interpretation. Partner with AppSec and compliance stakeholders to ensure safe handling of sensitive data in prompts, logs, and test artifacts.
  
  
**C / Pro\*C Engineering & Legacy Platform Integration:**
Contribute to and review C and Pro\*C codebases, including embedded SQL and database interaction patterns, to ensure Copilot guidance and templates align with real legacy architecture, coding conventions, and production behavior. Work confidently in Linux and Unix environments, including shell commands/scripts, build and make processes, compilation/linking, runtime diagnostics, log analysis, and batch/job execution. Analyze, debug, maintain, and enhance large brownfield and legacy codebases with limited documentation; trace dependencies and data flows across C/Pro\*C modules, scripts, database objects, and interfaces while preserving existing behavior.
  
  
**GenAI Solution Engineering (Supporting):**
Develop LLM-powered workflows on Azure (Azure OpenAI) to support developer experience and engineering insights (e.g., PR summarization, guided debugging, quality dashboards). Implement prompt contracts, tool/function calling patterns, and evaluation harnesses for reliability, cost, and safety. Where needed, build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and connectors to enterprise knowledge sources with grounding/citations.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
Must-Have
  
  
5–7 years of software engineering experience delivering production systems with strong engineering discipline (testing, reviews, CI/CD).Hands-on experience using GitHub Copilot in professional development workflows; ability to design and operationalize prompt files, custom instructions, and reusable agent-like workflows for teams.Practical hands-on experience with C and Pro\*C in Linux/Unix environments; able to read, debug, maintain, and enhance large legacy/brownfield codebases, including embedded SQL, build/make processes, shell scripts, and database interactions.
  
  
Strong GitHub fundamentals: branching strategies, PR-based delivery, code reviews, and GitHub Actions (or equivalent CI).Security-minded engineering: familiarity with secure coding practices and integrating automated checks (SAST, dependency scanning, secret detection) into the delivery pipeline.Azure fundamentals for deploying services (App Service/Functions/Container Apps) and secure configuration (Key Vault, RBAC).Ability to convert moderately detailed requirements into clear designs (ADRs/sequence diagrams) and production-ready implementations.
  
  
Nice-to-Have
  
  
GitHub Copilot administration experience (policy management, organizational customization, adoption measurement and reporting).Experience building developer tooling or IDE extensions (Visual Studio/VS Code), internal CLIs, or PR automation. Hands-on with GitHub Advanced Security (CodeQL, secret scanning, dependency review/Dependabot) and rulesets/required checks for merge gating.Experience with Azure OpenAI, prompt evaluation, and/or RAG (Azure AI Search or equivalent). Data engineering and analytics experience for telemetry pipelines and dashboards (SQL, data modeling, Power BI).
  
  
**What You Should Expect In This Role**

* Copilot customization assets (prompts/instructions/workflows) that materially improve cycle time and developer experience without compromising quality or security.
* Clear, trustworthy reporting of Copilot adoption and impact, including known limitations of telemetry and measurement.
* Reduced friction for common work (small fixes, bug triage, test creation) through repeatable Copilot-guided workflows that keep developers in control.
* Well-governed, secure AI-assisted development practices aligned with enterprise standards.
* Work from Office - Hyderabad location (5 days)

title: AI Engineering Lead
description:

**Hi-Tech City**
, Hyderabad, serves as

Now home to 1,000+ talented colleagues, we are shaping the future of entertainment across critical areas such as Customer Support Operations, Data & Technology, Business Operations (Finance, HR, Procurement), and HR Tech & Analytics.
  
  
Our Values define us. They are -
**Build Better Together, Own Every Outcome, Stay Curious and Grow, and Raise the Bar Every day.**
They're how we collaborate, grow, lead, and show up for each other every single day.
  
  
**Overview Of The Role**
Flutter Functions' AI & Automation team is looking for an expert
**AI Engineering Lead**
to build and lead a unit of 2–3 AI developers. You will be responsible for the technical vision and execution of Flutter's
**enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms**
, using internal data to enhance productivity and decision-making across our global sports betting and gaming operations.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining
**AI engineering, architecture, people leadership and cross-functional teamwork**
. You will shape engineering standards, make key architectural decisions, mentor your team, and help deliver production-grade AI systems serving over 20 million customers across 20+ regulated markets.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Technical Leadership & Architecture**

* Set the technical direction for our enterprise AI assistant and agent platforms, making architectural decisions across LLM inference, agentic frameworks, context engineering, guardrails and system design .
* Own the selection, deployment and optimisation of LLM inference systems including AWS Bedrock and LiteLLM , with a focus on model routing, cost, latency and operational excellence.
* Design production-grade context pipelines, RAG systems and prompt architectures , establishing patterns, standards and evaluation practices for the team.
* Guide architectural decisions around token economics, context limits, latency budgets and capability-to-cost trade-offs .
* Establish robust guardrails, security and Responsible AI practices , addressing prompt injection, data leakage, authentication, access control and sensitive data handling across regulated markets.
* Make informed technology choices across agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Strands and ADK , and establish scalable orchestration and tool-use patterns.
* Own problems end-to-end, from LLM integration and backend services through to user-facing interfaces, APIs and integrations using AWS services, MCP and modern engineering standards .

**People Leadership**

* Build, lead and mentor a pod of 2–3 AI developers , supporting their technical and career growth.
* Establish engineering standards through code reviews, architectural guidance and continuous technical development .
* Lead the team through production incidents, complex technical challenges and post-mortems, driving systemic improvements.
* Develop a culture of learning, experimentation, psychological safety and continuous improvement , while encouraging the team to challenge assumptions and take calculated technical risks.

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Partner with product managers and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and prioritise high-impact work.
* Collaborate with data scientists and platform engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into Flutter's existing infrastructure.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, present architectural decisions to leadership, and influence technical direction across teams.

**TO EXCEL IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED**
**Core Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI or a related STEM field , with 8–12 years of software development experience, including 2–3+ years focused on AI/ML or agentic systems development.
* Experience leading or mentoring technical teams , with the ability to establish technical direction and drive delivery through others.
* Advanced Python and backend engineering skills, including production experience with FastAPI, Flask and async patterns .
* Hands-on expertise with AWS Bedrock, LiteLLM or similar LLM inference platforms , including model routing, API design, cost optimisation and production deployment.
* Strong experience in context engineering, RAG and prompt architecture , and ability to evaluate trade-offs and design production-grade solutions.
* Deep experience with 2–3+ agentic frameworks , such as LangChain, LangGraph, Strands, ADK or CrewAI , including orchestration, tool use and multi-agent patterns.
* Experience designing and implementing guardrails, content filtering and Responsible AI practices in production environments.
* Strong AI security fundamentals , including prompt injection, data exfiltration, model misuse, OAuth, JWT and least-privilege design.
* Proficiency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or OpenCode , and ability to validate AI-generated code and guide others in their use.
* Expert knowledge of software engineering fundamentals , including SDLC, Git, API design, system architecture and collaborative engineering.
* Exceptional communication and influencing skills - ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and build consensus without relying on formal authority.

**Highly Desirable Skills**

* Full-stack experience across React, TypeScript, backend services and AI integration .
* Hands-on experience designing and operating production RAG systems and vector databases , including Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch or Weaviate.
* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and its implementation in AI agent systems.
* Contributions to AI/ML or agentic open-source frameworks such as LangChain or CrewAI.
* Experience in gaming, sports betting, financial services or other heavily regulated environments .
* A track record of growing engineers, building high-performing teams or leading technical initiatives that delivered material business impact.
* Demonstrated curiosity and thought leadership in AI, with an appetite for emerging technologies and the ability to form and defend informed technology choices.

**Benefits We Offer**

* Access to Learnerbly, Udemy, and a Self-Development Fund for upskilling.
* Career growth through Internal Mobility Programs.
* Comprehensive Health Insurance for you and dependents.
* Coverage of OPD Consultations and Full Body health checkup every year.
* Well-Being Fund and 24/7 Assistance Program for holistic wellness.
* Hybrid Model: 2 office days/week with flexible leave policies, including maternity, paternity, and sabbaticals.
* Free Meals, Cab Allowance, and a Home Office Setup Allowance.
* Employer PF Contribution, gratuity, Personal Accident & Life Insurance.
* Sharesave Plan to purchase discounted company shares.
* Volunteering Leave and Team Events to build connections.
* Recognition through the Kudos Platform and Referral Rewards.

**WHY CHOOSE US**
Flutter is an
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
and values the unique perspectives and experiences that everyone brings. We are committed to a fair and inclusive recruitment process where every candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed, with hiring decisions based on skills, experience and potential.
  
  
We have ambitious growth plans and goals for the future. Here's an opportunity for you to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of Flutter Entertainment India.
  
  
If you're passionate about this opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your skills, experiences, and perspective could make you a great fit for our team.

title: Principal Engineer – Knowledge, Data & RAG Engineering- Assistant Vice President
description:

Working with architecture, data, AI, security, risk, product, testing, and application teams, you will turn business strategy into practical architectures, standards, roadmaps, and delivery controls. You will bring strong architectural leadership and expertise in semantic technologies, modern data platforms, and retrieval systems.

Enterprise AI depends on trusted, well-engineered, permission-aware, traceable, and continuously validated data and knowledge. This role establishes the architectural foundation that connects source systems, data pipelines, semantic models, knowledge graphs, retrieval services, models, agents, controls, testing, and business workflows. The Architect will reduce fragmented point solutions, promote reusable capabilities, guide investment decisions, and ensure that AI applications and agents retrieve reliable evidence, generate grounded responses, execute approved actions, and remain secure, observable, auditable, resilient, and compliant throughout their lifecycle.

We turn the deep expertise locked inside our implementation teams into engineered processes, governed knowledge and intelligent agents that cut manual effort, compress client go-live timelines and make every implementation faster and more predictable than the last.
  
  
We operate as one global team across the North America, EMEA, and APAC, combining process engineering, automation delivery, AI platform engineering and responsible-AI governance under a single roof. We work on real client implementations, not pilots that sit on a shelf — what we build is adopted, measured and scaled. If you want to shape how AI is applied to one of the most complex delivery landscapes in financial services, this is the team to do it in.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
Own the enterprise architecture for Knowledge Engineering, Data Engineering, RAG and Graph RAG, Agentic AI, testing, and governance, aligning strategy, platforms, delivery, controls, and measurable outcomes.
  
  

* Define the enterprise vision, target architecture, standards, reusable patterns, and roadmap across data, knowledge, retrieval, AI agents, testing, and governance.

We value pragmatic architecture, business-value alignment, secure-by-design and test-by-design practices, reuse, interoperability, measurable quality, transparent decision making, and continuously governed enterprise AI outcomes.
  
  
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  
**Must-have Skills**

* Strong experience in enterprise architecture, technical leadership, and working with cross-functional teams.
* Strong data engineering expertise across ETL/ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, lakehouse or warehouse platforms, data quality, and DataOps.

* Familiarity with AI platforms or frameworks such as Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Vertex AI, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or MLflow would be beneficial.

* An understanding of cloud costs, capacity planning, and communicating architecture proposals to senior stakeholders would be useful.

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred; a master’s degree would be a plus.

title: Data & AI Architect
description:
Reporting to the Head of Data & AI and leading a small team of specialists, the role owns three things: Azure-based AI/BI and agentic offerings; Mivada's Responsible AI, data governance and AI assurance framework; and the Microsoft Data & AI partnership.
  
  
This role works alongside the Enterprise Architecture & Snowflake COE, the Solutioning & Databricks COE, Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement, and Client Engagement & Execution, and drives the governance, training and adoption program set out in Mivada's AI Strategy & Roll-Out Roadmap across the practice.
  
  
Team leadership and people management
  
  

* Lead and manage a team of 3–5 Azure AI/BI engineers and AI / data governance specialists, owning their performance, development and day-to-day workload allocation.
* Recruit, onboard and develop team members; act as the escalation point for technical, governance and client issues the team raises.
* Set goals and conduct regular performance reviews for direct reports; identify and act on development and career-progression needs.

Azure AI/BI and agentic solution design and delivery
  
  

* Design, build and productionise AI/BI and generative AI solutions on Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Foundry, including natural-language analytics (for example, Fabric data agents and Copilot in Power BI).
* Develop and orchestrate agentic AI workflows (for example, Foundry Agent Service, Copilot Studio or LangGraph-style supervisor/agent patterns) that connect governed enterprise data, models and knowledge sources to real business problems.
* Package proven patterns into named, reusable, sellable offerings with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead, contributing to the practice's goal of at least one client-facing AI-enabled capability.
* Hand over to Client Engagement delivery pods with clear designs, guardrails and runbooks, and provide technical assurance through delivery.

Data governance and trust
  
  

* Own the practice's data governance approach for AI and analytics: ownership and stewardship, classification, lineage, quality and cataloguing, using Microsoft Purview and, where relevant, Unity Catalog or Snowflake Horizon.
* Develop and deliver client-facing trust offerings such as AI governance operating models, data governance and AI-readiness assessments, and Copilot data-protection reviews.

Microsoft Data & AI partnership
  
  

* Own Mivada's Microsoft Data & AI partner relationship and partner-tier roadmap, including the Solutions Partner for Data & AI (Azure) designation and relevant specialisations.
* Lead Microsoft co-sell, joint go-to-market and partner-funded programs (for example, workshops, assessments and proofs of concept) together with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead.
* Build and maintain certified Microsoft Data & AI capability across the practice, including own hands-on delivery.
* Represent Mivada at Microsoft partner forums and build relationships with Microsoft partner development managers and solution specialists.

Internal AI enablement and capability uplift
  
  

* Build and maintain the reusable prompt/playbook library and templated workflows that move staff from ad hoc use (L1/L2) toward governed, team-level and client-facing use (L3+) on the practice's AI maturity scale.
* Recruit, train and coordinate the peer-coach network; deliver the role-based training tiers, including Responsible AI and AI literacy for all staff; track adoption, confidence and training completion each quarter.

Client and stakeholder engagement
  
  

* Partner with the Pre-Sales, Propositions & Industry Engagement lead on AI and governance pursuits, providing solution design, estimates and Responsible AI positions for proposals.
* Contribute Responsible AI and data-trust thought leadership, such as points of view, events and case studies, to build Mivada's reputation and visibility.
* Advise client executives and risk, privacy and compliance stakeholders on AI governance, guardrails and trade-offs in clear, non-technical terms.
* Keep current with the Azure, Fabric and Foundry roadmap and with AI regulation and standards; coach consultants in Azure AI delivery and Responsible AI practice.

**Essential**
**QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Demonstrated experience leading and developing a small technical team (line management, performance reviews, resourcing and capacity planning).
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Senior experience in data and AI engineering or consulting, with hands-on delivery on Microsoft Azure data and AI services (for example, Microsoft Fabric, Foundry, Azure OpenAI and Power BI).
* Practical experience building and productionising generative AI, natural-language analytics or agentic AI solutions.
* Experience designing or running enablement or training programs.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including with executive, risk and compliance audiences.

**Desirable**

* HIGHLY DESIRABLE – Data, Agentic or AI certification across one or more of MS Azure, Databricks, Snowflake
* AI governance or data governance credentials (for example, IAPP AIGP, ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer or DAMA CDMP).
* Experience managing a Microsoft partner relationship, including designation or specialisation audits and co-sell.
* Prior consulting or professional services experience; experience running a champion network or community of practice.

**Benefits**
**WHY JOIN US**
Everyone who joins our team is treated as a trusted member of the team, not a number. Ultimately your success is our success, so we invest in our People heavily. Here are the top reasons to join us:
  
  

* Developing you is a key focus - we help you craft your career
* Pioneers in Parental Leave benefits - we provide equality in our parental leave for all genders and parental types
* Doona Days - additional two days off for your mental health
* Fun is an everyday experience - we challenge you in a positive way so you enjoy your growth journey
* Competitive Compensation & Pay for Performance
* Opportunities to be more for yourself and others

**Who We Are**
At
**Mivada**
we believe that when you bring technology and the right people together, there's no limit to what you can achieve.
  
  
Mivada is a high-growth technology consultancy, headquartered in Australia, offering services to both high-growth, mid-sized and global blue chip clients. We run a hybrid model with the majority of our team onshore, as well as an offshore capability in India. We have the ability to support global businesses 24/7 365. Our flexible approach and strong reputation have led to repeat work and growth.
**Our clients are our advocates.**

We operate as a team, supporting and learning from each other and we genuinely care about our clients’ success. Our Leaders are accessible, humble, and sometimes pretty funny! We like to enjoy our time at work, which means we encourage each other to shoot for the moon!

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Semantic BI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Manager**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : Guide / 7-12 years**
**Primary Skill Area : Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence**
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: Guide / 7-12 years
* 7+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
  
  
fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud-native, AI-integrated applications and/or re-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI-DLC application development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and build well-architected, cloud-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
  
  
Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
  
  
Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
  
  
Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost-optimized
  
  
Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS ProServe IN - Karnataka

title: Data Engineering SMTS/LMTS
description:
**Description**
About Salesforce
  
  
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
**Department Overview**
The Revenue Analytics team builds the data platforms, intelligent products, modern application capabilities, and AI-enabled automation that power enterprise decision-making. We combine deep engineering expertise with business context to deliver trusted, scalable systems that support both human and agent-driven workflows.
  
  
Our team partners with business and technology leaders to solve complex challenges through modern data architecture, governed data products, integrated app services, and agentic systems. We emphasize production reliability, measurable business value, and responsible automation—not experimentation without operational accountability.
  
  
**Role Description: Hands On Data Lead & Systems Integrator**
We are seeking a
**Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS)**
to serve as a primary technical execution lead across our core data platform and its application integration interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role. While operating within the overarching platform architecture established by Principal Engineers, you will own the delivery of high-impact data engineering projects, build resilient pipelines, and ensure data products seamlessly plug into downstream applications, web tools, and agentic workflows. You will bring deep expertise in core data engineering (Python, Snowflake, dbt, SQL) complemented by solid working knowledge of the app development ecosystem (Node.js, APIs, microservices) to bridge data platforms with full-stack systems. You will lead project-level execution, mentor senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into production-ready software.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Data Engineering Project Leadership & Execution: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of end-to-end data pipelines for batch and event-driven workloads. Own project-level technical delivery, write high-performance production code, and guide team members to deliver scalable data products on schedule.
* Data Platform & Product Design: Define patterns for data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and storage using Python, SQL, dbt, Snowflake, and Airflow. Establish standards for data contracts, semantic consistency, lineage, and reusable data assets to support both business analytics and AI applications.
* App Ecosystem & Integration Layering: Design and maintain lightweight API integration components, Node.js services, and middleware that expose data platform capabilities to full-stack applications, web dashboards, and external enterprise platforms (Salesforce, AWS).
* Agentic Architecture & Tool Integration: Implement enterprise-controlled agentic capabilities and AI-enabled workflows. Integrate autonomous agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers into application endpoints and data pipelines, ensuring structured outputs, context retrieval, and clear human-agent handoffs.
* Verification & Production Reliability: Establish testing strategies, CI/CD pipelines, performance tuning, and operational observability across both data pipelines and app integration services. Define and enforce SLOs/SLAs for pipeline availability, data freshness, and API endpoint performance.
* Cross-Team Leadership & Quality Standards: Conduct code and design reviews. Mentor Senior and Associate Engineers, championing engineering standards for clean code, automated testing, and documentation across both data and application interfaces.

**Technical Profile**

* Core Data Engineering Foundations:
* Deep expertise in Python and advanced SQL, with a strong background in operating production data platforms.
* Extensive experience with data stack technologies: dbt, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, and Snowflake (including query optimization, performance tuning, cost management, and complex troubleshooting).
* Command of distributed systems, dimensional/domain-oriented data modeling, batch/streaming patterns, and Data Mesh / data-as-a-product concepts.
* Application Ecosystem & Integration Knowledge:
* Practical experience with Node.js and TypeScript / JavaScript for building lightweight backend services, microservices, or integration layers.
* Hands-on knowledge of designing and consuming REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, and event queues (Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS).
* Understanding of web app integration patterns, API gateways, and enterprise authentication protocols (OAuth2, SSO).
* AI & Agentic Engineering:
* Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled workflows using frameworks like LangGraph or LangChain.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, structured outputs, context engineering, vector stores, and retrieval mechanisms.
* Effective use of AI-native developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Codex, Claude Code) with rigorous review and testing of generated code.
* Cloud & DevOps Infrastructure:
* Hands-on experience operating on cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Familiarity with Docker, container orchestration (Kubernetes/ECS), serverless deployment (Lambda), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

**Qualifications**

* Experience: Typically 10 to 14+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or Platform Engineering (or equivalent demonstrated technical depth).
* Execution Leadership: Proven track record of leading complex data projects from requirements through architecture, deployment, and ongoing operation.
* Hybrid Systems Knowledge: Ability to serve as the bridge between core data platform engineering (Python/SQL/Snowflake) and web application developer teams (Node.js/APIs).
* Business & Communication Skills: Ability to translate technical implementation choices into business outcomes, work closely with product managers, and communicate effectively across engineering teams.

title: Software Development Engineer (SE-III)
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
Software Development Engineer III (SDE-III)
  
  
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day—building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with limitless entrepreneurial spirit, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Development Engineer III will play a critical role in designing, building, and scaling full-stack AI-powered systems that drive critical business workflows.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Software Development Engineer III is a senior individual contributor responsible for owning end-to-end full-stack solutions — from cloud-native backend services and APIs to modern front-end interfaces — built for scale, reliability, and performance. This role requires deep technical expertise across the stack, hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure, and the ability to evaluate and integrate emerging AI/ML technologies into production-grade engineering workflows. The Software Development Engineer III delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable technical solutions.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and the establishment of engineering best practices that raise the bar across the team.
* Contribute to a strong engineering culture by proactively sharing knowledge, championing code quality and observability standards, and supporting a collaborative, high-performance team environment.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build and maintain highly reliable, performant systems that directly power the digital experiences fans interact with across Fanatics Commerce's global platform.
* Ensure solutions are designed with scalability and uptime in mind, minimizing disruption and delivering consistent, seamless fan-facing functionality.
* Translate business and product requirements into technical designs that keep the fan experience at the center of every architectural decision.
* Drive improvements to system observability and monitoring so that issues impacting fans are identified and resolved rapidly.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Evaluate and integrate the latest AI/ML tools and frameworks — including LLM-based agents, RAG pipelines, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI copilots — into product and engineering workflows to drive automation and efficiency.
* Stay current with emerging technologies, industry trends, and company-wide AI initiatives, and proactively bring relevant innovations into the team's roadmap.
* Architect and deploy cloud-native applications on AWS, leveraging services such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, DynamoDB, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM to build secure, scalable infrastructure.
* Identify and prototype new approaches to reduce technical debt, improve system performance, and unlock new capabilities for the business.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Own the full software development lifecycle — design, coding, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration — with an uncompromising focus on code quality, security, and reliability.
* Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and scalability risks, and drive initiatives to resolve them before they impact the business.
* Operate with a strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, making sound technical decisions without waiting for direction.
* Consistently deliver complex, full-stack systems end-to-end with a track record of high-quality outcomes on time and at scale.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Agentic AI & Voice Agents
description:
**Role overview**

We are hiring a senior AI engineer to build and lead agentic AI systems: LLM agents that plan, call tools

and complete real business tasks end to end. You will build agents that hold live phone and web

conversations — streaming speech recognition, reasoning and tool calls, and speech synthesis in real

time. You will stay hands-on while setting technical direction, owning the evaluation system that proves

each agent works before every release, and helping a team of AI engineers move use cases from a demo

to a reliable, observable service that clients trust with their customers.

**Key responsibilities**

**Agentic systems**

• Design and build LLM agents that plan, call tools and complete multi-step business tasks across

voice, chat and back-office channels.

• Implement task and conversation state, memory and context management, retrieval (RAG) and

model routing between fast and more capable models.

• Define tool schemas and permissions, validate every tool call, and add human approval points

for high-impact actions.

• Build durable workflows with checkpoints, retries, idempotency keys, timeouts and

compensation for failed actions.

• Use multi-agent designs, such as a router with specialist agents, only where they measurably

beat a single agent.

• Integrate CRMs, ticketing systems and databases for actions such as complaint registration,

classification, routing, status updates and notifications, with warm human handoff.

**Voice agents**

• Build streaming pipelines that connect telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) and WebRTC audio to ASR,

LLMs and TTS over WebSockets.

• Implement voice activity detection, turn detection, barge-in and cancellation so the agent stops

talking the moment a caller speaks.

• Set and hold latency budgets per hop (ASR, LLM, TTS, network), with a target of under [1 s] from

end of caller speech to first agent audio.

• Adapt agent behaviour for speech: short turns, confirmations before actions, and recovery from

mishearing.

• Support multilingual and code-switched calls, including language detection and matching TTS

voices.

**Evaluation**

• Build and maintain golden test sets that define the user goal, persona, expected tool calls and

pass criteria for each scenario.

• Run trajectory evals that check each step, tool choice, arguments and order, not just the final

answer.

• Run simulated-caller evals for voice: an LLM plays the caller, TTS voices it with accents, noise

and interruptions, and the agent is tested end to end over real audio.

• Score task success, tool-call correctness, policy compliance, hallucination, word error rate and

latency, using rule checks and LLM judges calibrated against human ratings.

• Gate releases in CI on eval results, block regressions, and turn every confirmed production

failure into a new test case.

**Backend and operations**

• Write async Python services (FastAPI, asyncio) with structured logging, tracing and metrics for

every agent run and conversation.

• Load-test concurrent sessions, find bottlenecks and keep p95 latency and per-task model cost

within budget.

• Protect sensitive data: authentication and authorisation, audit trails for agent actions, PII

redaction and tenant isolation.

• Ship with Docker and CI using staged releases and rollback, and troubleshoot live agents in

production.

• Work with product and delivery teams to turn client workflows into working agent integrations.

**Technical leadership**

• Own the architecture of agent and voice systems, document key decisions and explain trade-offs

to engineers, product and clients.

• Break client requirements into technical designs and delivery milestones, and assign work across

the team.

• Review code and designs, and set team standards for testing, evaluation, monitoring and

release.

• Mentor AI engineers through pairing, design reviews and feedback, and help them grow into

owning features end to end.

• Lead incident response for production issues, run blameless post-mortems and drive the fixes to

completion.

**Required qualifications and skills**

• Strong Python and backend skills: APIs, asyncio, WebSockets, structured error handling and

automated tests.

• Hands-on experience shipping LLM agents beyond a prompt demo: tool calling, state

management, RAG and failure handling in a real workflow.

• Sound judgement on agent design: when a fixed workflow beats an autonomous agent, single

versus multi-agent, and how to keep agents safe with permissions and guardrails.

• Working knowledge of a real-time voice stack: streaming ASR and TTS, VAD, turn-taking and the

trade-offs between latency and accuracy.

• Experience designing evaluations for LLM agents: test sets, trajectory and outcome metrics,

LLM-as-judge and regression tracking — and knowing when a metric is misleading.

• Ability to debug across services using logs, traces and recorded sessions to find where an agent

failed or slowed down.

• Experience with SQL or NoSQL databases, Git, Docker and CI pipelines.

• Evidence of owning production services from design through operation, including reliability

under real traffic.

• Experience mentoring engineers, reviewing their work and leading technical decisions with

product or client stakeholders.

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with clear examples of

delivered work.

**Preferred experience**

• Agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Temporal or

MCP tool servers.

• Production voice agents on telephony (SIP, Twilio, Exotel) or WebRTC, with frameworks such as

LiveKit Agents or Pipecat.

• Speech providers such as Deepgram, Whisper, Google STT, ElevenLabs, Azure TTS or Cartesia,

and measuring their WER and latency on your own data.

• Indian-language and code-switched speech (Hindi, Telugu, Tamil and English).

• Queues, caching and event-driven systems (Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ), and load-testing tools such

as Locust or k6.

• Access controls, PII redaction and on-premises or restricted-network deployments.

• Other modalities, such as vision or document understanding (images, screenshots, scanned

forms), and combining them with voice or text in one agent.

**Success in the role**

Success means AI agents — voice, chat or back-office — that complete real business tasks reliably, with

evidence that they work, and a team that ships them with confidence. In your first six months, that looks

like:

• Business outcomes: agents measurably resolve tasks without human help, cut handling time

and raise customer satisfaction for client use cases.

• Reliability: workflows recover from timeouts, tool failures and bad input; write actions are

never duplicated; every incident is traced to a cause and fixed.

• Evaluation culture: every release is gated by evals, metrics track what users actually experience,

and production failures flow back into the test sets.

• Performance and cost: latency and per-task model cost stay within agreed budgets as traffic

grows.

• Delivery: client requirements become working integrations on schedule, with clear handover to

product and delivery teams.

• Engineering quality: features are tested, observable, documented and easy for others to

maintain.

• Team growth: architecture decisions are documented, engineers you mentor own features end

to end, and the team ships faster with fewer production issues.

* Evaluate emerging technologies through structured prototypes and recommend adoption based on security, operability, cost, maintainability and business fit.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for coding, testing, documentation and developer productivity while ensuring human review and compliance

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of production applications.

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in:

+ Computer Science
+ Information Technology
+ Artificial Intelligence
+ Data Science
+ Software Engineering
+ Computer Engineering
+ Or a related technical discipline

title: AI Engineer
description:
