title: Sr Associate– Image Analysis & Digital Pathology
description:
**Job Description:**
At
**Amgen**
, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, developing, and delivering ever-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide.
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated
**Senior Associate– Image Analysis & Digital Pathology**
to join our Computational Imaging and Digital Biomarkers team. The successful candidate will contribute to the development and application of computational pathology and AI/ML methods to support translational research, biomarker discovery, and precision medicine initiatives across therapeutic areas.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with pathologists, data scientists, translational scientists, and software engineers to build scalable image analysis workflows and generate quantitative insights from complex imaging datasets including whole-slide pathology images and spatial biology platforms.
  
  
**Live – What You Will Do**
In this vital role, you will:
  
  

* Develop and apply image analysis, computer vision, and machine learning methods for digital pathology datasets.
* Design and implement analysis pipelines for whole-slide imaging (WSI), H&E, IHC, multiplex immunofluorescence, and spatial omics datasets.
* Build reproducible and scalable workflows using Python and modern ML/DL frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Perform tissue segmentation, cell phenotyping, feature extraction, and spatial analysis using state-of-the-art computational approaches.
* Collaborate with pathologists and translational teams to interpret image-derived biomarkers and biological findings.
* Contribute to evaluation, validation, and benchmarking of image analysis algorithms and workflows.
* Support deployment and operationalization of computational imaging pipelines in cloud or high-performance computing environments.
* Stay current with advances in computational pathology, AI/ML, and spatial biology technologies.

**Win – What We Expect Of You**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* PhD or MS in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related quantitative discipline.
* Strong background in computer vision, image analysis, and machine learning/deep learning.
* Demonstrated experience working with biomedical imaging data (pathology preferred).
* Proven track record in developing, validating, and deploying advanced computer vision and deep learning algorithms, including contributions to released products.
* Proficiency in Python and common ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).
* Deep understanding of image analysis methods such as segmentation, object detection, and classification, ideally within digital pathology (e.g., histopathology, tissue imaging) and/or spatial omics.
* Familiarity with large-scale data management and cloud-based computational environments.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in computational imaging, digital pathology, or medical image analysis.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience with scientific computing libraries.
* Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Experience analyzing pathology imaging modalities including H&E, IHC, multiplex IF, or spatial transcriptomics data.
* Familiarity with whole-slide imaging tools and digital pathology platforms such as QuPath, HALO, Visiopharm, or OpenSlide.
* Understanding of machine learning methods for segmentation, classification, detection, and representation learning.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills in multidisciplinary scientific environments.
* Track record of scientific publications, conference presentations, or applied translational research contributions is preferred.

**Thrive – What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional growth and well-being:
  
  

* A collaborative and diverse global team environment
* Opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies in biomedical research
* Training and mentoring to support your career path
* Flexibility in work arrangements and work-life balance

title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.

description:

**Principal Member of Technical Staff — ROCm Validation & System-Level Quality**
**About The Role**
We are seeking a
**Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS)**
to serve as the senior technical leader for
**ROCm software validation**
across compute workloads and server-class systems. In this individual-contributor leadership role, you will define
*how AMD proves ROCm is ready to ship*
— from unit and component testing, through full-stack workload validation, to multi-node system-level qualification on AMD Instinct™ GPU platforms. You will set the technical direction for validation strategy, build and evolve the test infrastructure that gates every ROCm release, and personally drive the hardest debugging, characterization, and qualification problems. Your work directly determines the quality bar experienced by hyperscalers, OEMs, sovereign-AI customers, and the open-source community running ROCm in production.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the end-to-end validation architecture for ROCm — unit, integration, framework, workload, performance, stress, stability, scale-out, and system-level test layers — across multiple GPU generations and server platforms.
* Define release-qualification gates and exit criteria for ROCm software releases (functional coverage, performance regressions, stability hours, scale targets, RAS criteria) and drive the org to meet them.
* Lead system-level testing for server nodes — multi-GPU topologies, PCIe/Infinity Fabric/xGMI, BMC/IPMI, thermal/power, firmware interactions, and multi-node fabric (Ethernet/InfiniBand/UALink) bring-up and validation.
* Drive compute workload validation and characterization — LLM training and inference (PyTorch, vLLM, Triton, JAX), recommender systems, scientific HPC kernels, MLPerf-class benchmarks — establishing reproducible methodology, baselines, and regression tracking.
* Architect the test infrastructure — distributed test runners, GitHub Actions / Jenkins / internal CI fleets, hardware lab orchestration, result data lakes, flaky-test detection, bisection automation, and self-service developer pre-submit pipelines.
* Champion modern, agile quality engineering — shift-left testing, test pyramids, contract testing between layers, hermetic test environments, deterministic reproducers, and continuous validation in trunk.
* Set the bar for GitHub-based quality workflows — PR gating policy, required checks, code-coverage standards, bug-bash and triage cadences, and disciplined issue management across ROCm/\* repositories and partner upstream projects.
* Lead complex escalation debug — partner with development, hardware, firmware, and customer-facing teams to root-cause the hardest multi-day, multi-node, multi-component failures and convert findings into durable test coverage.
* Influence the roadmap — work with product management, silicon, platform, and software architecture to ensure validation readiness for next-generation Instinct GPUs and server platforms before tape-in milestones and silicon arrival.
* Mentor and elevate Senior and Staff validation engineers, SDETs, and SQA leads; raise the technical bar through design review, code review, and written guidance.
* Represent ROCm validation externally — strategic customer engagements, OEM qualification programs, and open-source community quality initiatives.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 12+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong validation, SDET, or quality-engineering focus, including 5+ years in a senior IC role (Staff/Principal/PMTS or equivalent) leading validation of complex systems software.
* BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent demonstrated experience).
* Expert-level Python for test automation and infrastructure; strong C++ for debugging, and extending production code paths under test.
* Deep, demonstrable validation experience in at least two of the following domains:
* GPU compute software stacks (ROCm, CUDA, oneAPI, SYCL)
* Deep-learning frameworks and inference engines (PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Triton, vLLM)
* HPC / parallel runtimes and communication libraries (MPI, RCCL/NCCL, UCX, Libfabric)
* Linux kernel, GPU drivers, or accelerator firmware
* Distributed systems and large-scale cluster software
* System-level validation for server-class compute nodes— multi-GPU, multi-node, fabric-attached environments — including stress/stability, soak, fault-injection, and RAS testing.
* Proven, hands-on experience working efficiently in an agentic AI engineering environment — daily, production use of LLM-based coding agents (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot Workspace, Codex-class agents) and orchestration frameworks for real engineering work, with demonstrable productivity, quality, or coverage gains attributable to those workflows. Comfort designing prompts, tool/MCP integrations, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails for autonomous and semi-autonomous agents.
* Hands-on experience defining and shipping release qualification programs for software consumed by hyperscalers, OEMs, or other Tier-1 customers.
* Mastery of GitHub at scale for quality engineering — PR gating, GitHub Actions, self-hosted runners, required status checks, release tagging, and open-source contribution and triage norms.
* Strong command of modern, agile software development practices — trunk-based development, CI/CD, shift-left testing, observability, feature flags, and incremental delivery — applied specifically to validation organizations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — able to author crisp test plans, qualification reports, RFCs, and post-mortems, and to influence development teams without authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct contributions to validation, CI, or test infrastructure for ROCm, PyTorch, LLVM, Triton, vLLM, or comparable upstream open-source projects.
* Demonstrated leadership in agentic-AI adoption — built or rolled out agent-based workflows across an engineering team (e.g., autonomous test generation, AI-driven log/triage pipelines, multi-agent debug systems, MCP server design, retrieval-augmented engineering knowledge bases) with measurable outcomes.
* Experience operating or validating large GPU clusters (256+ GPUs) — fabric bring-up, cluster health monitoring, and fleet-level diagnostics.
* Familiarity with Training/Inference/HPC industry-standard benchmark methodologies and submissions.
* Background in performance validation: roofline analysis, profiler tooling (rocprof, Omniperf, Nsight-class), regression detection
* Experience with fault injection, RAS, telemetry, and long-haul stability programs for accelerator platforms.
* Familiarity with hardware lab automation: BMC/IPMI/Redfish, PDU control, serial-console capture, automated re-imaging, and topology-aware test scheduling.
* Prior experience standing up validation for pre-silicon / emulation / first-silicon bring-up of accelerators.

**Why This Role**
ROCm powers AI and HPC workloads on AMD Instinct GPUs at the largest scale in the industry. The quality of every ROCm release is felt across millions of GPUs in production — and the validation organization is what stands between "code complete" and "customer ready." As Principal MTS for ROCm Validation, you will define that bar, build the systems that enforce it, and personally lead the toughest qualification problems on AMD's most strategic platforms.

In the role of AI Platform Build Executive Director within EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team, you will be at the helm of pioneering AI/ML and Agentic project deliveries, with a keen focus on leveraging AWS or Azure GenAI, NLP, and Transformer models to drive innovation and solve complex challenges. * Direct the complete lifecycle management of advanced analytics, Agentic ML, AI, and GenAI initiatives, with a focus on NLP and Transformer models, ensuring flawless integration with cloud services.
* Act as a mentor to junior team members, providing them with the training and insights needed to become proficient in AI/ML and cloud technologies.
* Display outstanding project management skills, leading the charge in the successful delivery of complex AI/ML projects, adhering to tight deadlines, and exceeding client expectations.

* Analytical Problem Solving – Possess the ability to dissect problems from a holistic perspective, rather than being constrained by specific techniques.
* Planning: Demonstrate the capacity to make significant contributions to both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning.
* Industry Knowledge - Stay informed about the latest developments in Data Science and AI, and adeptly apply this knowledge to a variety of scenarios.
* Integrated View - Skillfully consolidate diverse perspectives, data sources, and methodologies to address and resolve client issues effectively.
* Relationship Management - Cultivate and maintain strong, healthy relationships and partnerships with clients, EY partners, senior leaders, and team members at all levels.
* Knowledge of Analytical Tools - Have a solid understanding of the foundational features of Data Science tools such as Python, R, or SAS.

**Skills and Attributes for Success:**

* Exceptional technical acumen in AWS cloud services, GenAI, NLP, and Transformer AI/ML models, coupled with a track record of successful implementations.
* Outstanding project management prowess, characterized by a methodical and results-driven approach to overseeing intricate AI/ML initiatives from concept to completion.
* Superior communication skills, with a talent for distilling complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and accessible language for a diverse array of stakeholders.
* Strategic insight and foresight, contributing to the overarching vision and strategic direction of the Data Sciences team, while staying attuned to the latest industry trends and technological advancements.
* Oversee ethical AI practices, ensuring fairness, accountability, and transparency in AI systems.
* Expert in AI governance, implementing and monitoring responsible AI frameworks.
* Manage risk and compliance with regulatory and ethical standards for AI deployment.
* Champion ethical decision-making in AI development and operational processes.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Quantitative Methods, or a related field; advanced degrees or certifications in cloud/Agentic technologies (AWS, Azure) are strongly preferred.
* An MBA or equivalent experience in business management is highly valued.
* Relevant experience in advanced analytical/AI/Agentic Platform Build roles of 3-5 years
* Demonstrated expertise in deploying AI/ML solutions on AWS or any other Hyperscaler and a deep understanding of advanced data modeling techniques.

**What We Offer:**

* A leadership position within a globally recognized team at the cutting edge of AI/ML innovation, providing the opportunity to work on transformative projects with significant impact.
* Access to an extensive network of professionals and resources across the globe, fostering an environment conducive to continuous learning and career advancement.
* A diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates individuality and encourages the expression of ideas, facilitating collaborative team efforts and personal growth.
* Comprehensive support and guidance to develop into a transformative leader, equipped to navigate and excel in today's rapidly evolving technological landscape.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Scientist - Materials Science Software, Hyderabad (Heterogeneous Catalysis & Surface Modeling)
description:
Schrödinger, a science and technology leader with over 35 years of experience providing solutions for atomic-scale modeling and physics-based chemical simulations, is seeking a materials science developer to build advanced software tools and automated workflows for heterogeneous catalysis and surface chemistry modeling.
  
  
We are seeking a developer with a PhD in Materials Science, Computational Chemistry or Physics, or Chemical Engineering, combining deep domain knowledge in density functional theory (DFT) reactivity with strong software engineering skills in Python to accelerate catalyst design and chemical process modeling.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop robust software tools for automated surface slab generation, adsorption site mapping, and catalytic surface reaction kinetics.
* Implement algorithms and workflows for periodic electronic structure calculations, nudged elastic band (NEB) path generation, and surface energetics analysis.
* Maintain clean, documented code and actively participate in team code reviews and collaborative software releases.

**Required Qualifications**

* PhD in Materials Science, Computational Chemistry or Physics, Chemical Engineering, or related field.
* Solid technical background in periodic DFT applications (surfaces, interfaces, solid-state materials, or electrocatalytic/heterocatalytic systems).
* Hands-on experience running and automating periodic electronic structure codes (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, VASP, CP2K, CASTEP).

**Desirable Qualifications**

* Experience implementing or automating Nudged Elastic Band (NEB), grand canonical DFT, or implicit solvation models for solid interfaces.
* Experience developing graphical user interface (GUI) components or visualization modules for periodic lattices and surface slabs.
* Familiarity with microkinetic modelling of catalytic systems

title: Engineering Lead-AI Agentic Platform
description:
Engineering Lead
  
  
AI Agentic Platform Orchestration, Benchmarking & Unification
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to build, architect, and lead the team behind our next-generation AI Agentic Platform. This platform empowers enterprises to measure ROI on industry-specific agent activity, benchmark AI agents against performance standards, orchestrate complex multi-agent workflows, and unify AI agents seamlessly across diverse platforms and ecosystems.
  
  
As the engineering leader for this strategic product, you will combine deep technical expertise with strong people management skills to deliver a unified control plane for the rapidly evolving agentic AI landscape. You will own the technical vision, drive architectural decisions, and grow a high-performing team that ships at the frontier of AI engineering.
  
  
Platform Capabilities You'll Own
  
  

* Industry-Specific ROI Measurement: Build instrumentation, analytics, and reporting frameworks that quantify the business impact of AI agents across verticals such as BFSI, healthcare, retail, and telecom.
* AI Agent Benchmarking: Develop standardized evaluation harnesses, performance scoring, and quality metrics that allow enterprises to compare agents on accuracy, latency, cost, safety, and task success.
* Agent Orchestration: Design multi-agent orchestration engines, workflow planners, routing layers, and coordination frameworks that enable agents to collaborate on complex tasks reliably.
* Cross-Platform Agent Unification: Architect a unified abstraction layer, connectors, and protocol adapters (MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants, LangGraph, etc.) so customers can manage agents across vendors and frameworks from a single pane of glass.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Hire, build, and lead a high-caliber engineering team across backend, AI/ML, and platform infrastructure
* Define and own the technical architecture for a multi-tenant, scalable AI agentic platform
* Drive the technical roadmap for orchestration, benchmarking, observability, and unification capabilities
* Partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and GTM teams to translate customer needs into shippable engineering outcomes
* Establish engineering best practices for AI agent development, evaluation, safety, and deployment
* Lead architectural reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex distributed systems
* Build robust evaluation frameworks and ROI dashboards that customers and internal teams trust
* Ensure platform reliability, performance, security, and cost efficiency at scale
* Mentor engineers, set growth paths, run performance reviews, and foster an inclusive, high-trust team culture
* Communicate progress, risks, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience with at least 3+ years managing engineering teams
* Proven experience architecting and scaling distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native platforms
* Hands-on experience building AI/ML or LLM-powered products in production environments
* Strong understanding of agentic AI concepts including planning, tool use, memory, and multi-agent coordination
* Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Go, Java, or TypeScript
* Experience designing APIs, SDKs, and integration platforms used by enterprise customers
* Track record of recruiting, developing, and retaining strong engineering talent
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar)
* Familiarity with emerging agent interoperability standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocols
* Experience designing LLM evaluation and benchmarking systems (offline evals, A/B testing, golden datasets, judge models)
* Knowledge of observability for AI systems including tracing, telemetry, and cost/quality monitoring
* Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and prompt engineering at scale
* Background in building analytics, ROI dashboards, or business intelligence tooling for enterprise customers
* Domain experience in one or more verticals (BFSI, healthcare, retail, telecom, customer support, or sales)
* Familiarity with AI safety, guardrails, and responsible AI frameworks
* Master's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field

Technical Stack & Tooling
  
  

* Languages: Python, Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Java
* AI/ML Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, PyTorch, OpenAI/Anthropic/Google APIs
* Agent Protocols: MCP, A2A, OpenAI Assistants API, function calling, tool use frameworks
* Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Pinecone/Weaviate/Qdrant, Snowflake/BigQuery
* Streaming & Messaging: Kafka, Redis, RabbitMQ, gRPC
* Cloud & Infra: AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker
* Observability: Datadog, OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse, Prometheus, Grafana

What We're Looking For
  
  

* A builder-leader who can both architect deeply technical systems and grow a high-performing team
* Someone genuinely excited about agentic AI and the future of multi-agent enterprise systems
* A pragmatic decision-maker who can balance innovation, customer value, and engineering excellence
* A strong communicator who can simplify complex AI concepts for diverse audiences
* A coach and mentor who invests in people and builds inclusive, psychologically safe teams

Why Join Us
  
  

* Lead one of the most strategic AI initiatives at the company at the forefront of agentic AI
* Build a category-defining platform that unifies, benchmarks, and orchestrates AI agents across the enterprise
* Shape product and technical strategy alongside senior leadership
* Work with cutting-edge LLMs, agent frameworks, and evaluation tooling
* Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits
* Flexible work culture with strong investment in learning and development

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

Summary:
  
  
As a Senior AWS Integration Architect, you will design and implement enterprise-scale AWS integration platforms, cloud-native architectures, and metadata-driven integration frameworks. The role requires extensive expertise in AWS Glue-based data integration solutions, serverless architectures, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and modern cloud integration patterns.
  
  
The architect will leverage AWS services such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, CloudFormation, CDK (TypeScript), and CodeBuild to build scalable, secure, and high-performance integration solutions. Strong experience in Python, PySpark, SQL, and TypeScript is required, along with expertise in Data Mesh architectures, multi-tenant integration platforms, cross-account deployments, and event-driven integration patterns.
  
  
The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, and engineering teams to deliver cloud solutions using Agile methodologies, DevOps practices, and modern AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity and accelerate software delivery.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Design and architect enterprise-scale AWS Glue-based data integration solutions for cloud-native applications and Data Mesh platforms.
* Lead the design and implementation of serverless integration architectures using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, SQS, and AWS Glue.
* Develop and optimize AWS Glue ETL jobs using Python and PySpark for large-scale data processing and transformation.
* Design metadata-driven and configuration-over-code integration frameworks using JSON schemas and reusable architecture patterns.
* Build scalable, event-driven integration pipelines supporting JDBC, REST APIs, SFTP, and messaging-based integrations.
* Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using AWS CDK (TypeScript) and CloudFormation.
* Lead multi-tenant architecture decisions and cross-account deployment strategies across AWS environments.
* Develop backend services using TypeScript and Python for serverless applications.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodeBuild, Jenkins, GitHub, and DevOps best practices.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams to gather requirements, conduct architecture reviews, and deliver solution demonstrations.
* Ensure security, governance, monitoring, and operational excellence across AWS integration platforms.
* Optimize AWS solutions for performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Mentor development teams and establish best practices for cloud-native integration and automation.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to improve engineering productivity and accelerate SDLC processes.

The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.
  
  
We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.
  
  
You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.

* Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.

description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice
  
  
**Team Overview**
Our team is at the forefront of building next-generation AI-powered platforms and cloud-native solutions that enable the organization to accelerate innovation at scale. We develop reusable engineering capabilities, intelligent services, and enterprise-grade platforms that empower product teams, data scientists, and engineers to build, deploy, and operate secure, scalable, and reliable applications.
  
  
We work across the full technology stack, combining modern software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and Generative AI to solve complex business challenges. Our focus areas include Python engineering, cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform, AI/ML platforms, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI systems, platform reliability, and developer productivity.
  
  
The team values technical excellence, innovation, ownership, and continuous learning. Engineers are encouraged to experiment with emerging technologies, influence architectural direction, contribute to platform strategy, and collaborate closely with product, security, data science, and business stakeholders. We foster a culture where strong engineering fundamentals, operational excellence, and practical AI innovation come together to deliver meaningful business impact.
  
  
As part of this team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge technologies, solve large-scale engineering problems, and help shape the future of intelligent systems across the enterprise. You'll collaborate with highly skilled engineers, architects, and AI practitioners while helping establish engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices that drive success across multiple teams. This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.
  
  
**Role Overview**
**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**
We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Lead Engineer to design, build, and operate production-grade systems that span software engineering, cloud-native infrastructure, and AI-powered applications. The ideal candidate combines deep Python engineering expertise with strong cloud architecture skills on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and proven experience building and deploying Generative AI at enterprise scale. This role will define reusable engineering patterns and platform capabilities that enable multiple product, data science, and engineering teams to safely build, deploy, evaluate, and operate intelligent systems. The Lead Engineer will remain deeply technical while providing architecture leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing engineering standards across the organization.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Production Python Engineering: Design and develop high-performance, production-grade Python services and applications following modern software engineering best practices. Establish coding standards, design patterns, and reusable frameworks that enable teams to ship reliable software at velocity.
  
  
API Design & Microservices Architecture: Architect and build scalable microservices and RESTful/GraphQL APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI and Flask. Define service boundaries, communication patterns, and data contracts that support distributed system reliability and independent team ownership.
  
  
System Design & Distributed Systems: Lead the design of distributed, event-driven, and asynchronous systems that handle high throughput and low-latency requirements. Apply principles of concurrency, fault tolerance, and horizontal scaling to deliver resilient production architectures.
  
  
Testing Strategy & Engineering Quality: Define and drive comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing using pytest and related tooling. Champion code review practices, static analysis, and automated quality gates to maintain high engineering standards.
  
  
Reusable Libraries & SDKs: Identify repeated engineering patterns across teams and convert them into standardized Python libraries, SDKs, templates, and self-service platform capabilities that accelerate development and reduce duplication.
  
  
Cloud-Native Architecture (GCP): Design and implement cloud-native architectures on Google Cloud Platform using services such as GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, and App Engine. Establish patterns for containerization, orchestration, autoscaling, and resilient infrastructure that support production AI and software workloads.
  
  
Data Infrastructure & Pipelines: Architect scalable data infrastructure using BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, and Cloud Composer. Design data pipelines that support both real-time streaming and batch processing for analytics, ML training, and AI application data needs.
  
  
Infrastructure as Code & DevOps: Establish infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and CI/CD pipelines with Cloud Build or equivalent tooling. Drive automation of build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows to ensure repeatable, auditable, and fast delivery cycles.
  
  
Observability & Site Reliability: Implement end-to-end observability using Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, and custom metrics. Define SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets for production services and establish incident response practices that minimize mean time to recovery.
  
  
Cloud Security & Cost Optimization: Establish security best practices including IAM policies, VPC design, secrets management, and workload identity federation. Drive cloud cost optimization through resource right-sizing, committed use discounts, and efficient architecture patterns.
  
  
LLM Integration & GenAI Applications: Design and build production applications powered by large language models, integrating commercial and open-source models through well-defined abstraction layers. Establish patterns for prompt engineering, context management, structured outputs, and token optimization.
  
  
RAG & Knowledge Architecture: Design scalable Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, semantic and hybrid retrieval, reranking, and metadata-enriched knowledge stores. Implement GraphRAG and semantic models where appropriate to improve retrieval quality.
  
  
AI Evaluation & Quality: Define engineering standards for evaluating LLM applications and AI agents. Establish golden datasets, automated regression testing, retrieval evaluation, groundedness measurements, task-success metrics, and structured-output validation frameworks.
  
  
Model Serving & Inference: Design model integration and inference architectures on Vertex AI and equivalent platforms supporting commercial, private, and open-source models. Establish patterns for model selection, routing, fallback, versioning, latency optimization, and cost management.
  
  
Agentic AI & Orchestration: Define patterns for production agentic systems including tool calling, workflow orchestration, state and memory management, planning and execution, human-in-the-loop controls, retries, recovery, and long-running workflows.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Lead architecture and design reviews, resolve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and make pragmatic trade-offs across quality, speed, scalability, security, operational complexity, and cost.
  
  
Mentoring & Engineering Excellence: Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, review technical designs and code, raise engineering quality across the team, and help engineers adopt modern Python, cloud, and AI engineering practices.
  
  
Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with data scientists, platform teams, security, architecture, product management, and business stakeholders to translate enterprise requirements into scalable, production-ready solutions.
  
  
Technical Communication: Communicate technical strategy, architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs, and capabilities to engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and senior stakeholders with clarity and precision.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Knowledge And Experiences**
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
Experience: Typically 7+ years of software, platform, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including significant hands-on ownership of production systems and technical architecture. Demonstrated experience building production cloud-native applications on GCP and working with Generative AI or ML systems is required. Experience may span traditional software/platform engineering and newer AI engineering; candidates are not expected to have spent an unrealistic number of years specifically working with Generative AI.
  
  
Technical Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently design complex systems, lead technical execution across multiple engineers or teams, influence architecture, and convert emerging technologies into reliable enterprise capabilities.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
Expert-level proficiency in Python and strong production software engineering fundamentals. Experience with FastAPI, Flask, asyncio, pytest, and modern Python tooling. Familiarity with Java, Go, TypeScript, or another production language is advantageous.
  
  
Strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, API design, distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous programming, software architecture, automated testing, debugging, Git, and engineering best practices.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) including GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Vertex AI, Cloud Build, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. Experience with Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns including containerization, serverless, event-driven design, service mesh, autoscaling, and infrastructure as code. Experience designing for high availability, disaster recovery, and cost efficiency.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of deep learning and Transformer architectures, including tokenization, embeddings, attention, inference, and modern foundation-model architectures.
  
  
Experience with PyTorch, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable modern ML/AI frameworks.
  
  
Deep hands-on experience designing and building production applications using LLMs, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic AI patterns.
  
  
Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging for production systems.

Be part of this exciting journey where
**AI, Agentic AI, Data, Cloud, and innovation meet real-world impact at a global scale.**

What makes this opportunity unique is the scale, complexity, and impact.

**You will have the opportunity to:**

* Build AI products and solutions that operate across a truly global enterprise.
* Work at the intersection of industry, engineering, business transformation, and technology.
* Collaborate with leading experts from ArcelorMittal and strategic technology partners.
* Help establish standards, platforms, governance, and operating models that will shape our future AI landscape.
* Convert bold ideas into production-grade solutions that create measurable business value.
* Contribute to one of the most ambitious AI transformation programs currently underway in the industrial sector.

We’re looking for passionate
**AI Engineers, Data Specialists, Architects, Cloud Engineers, and technology innovators**
who want to solve complex challenges, build solutions from the ground up, and shape what comes next.

🔥
**Ready to take your AI career to the next level? Explore our open positions and apply now on LinkedIn. Come build the future of Industrial AI with ArcelorMittal!**

**Job Title –**
Agentic AI Engineering Lead (Agent Engineering Practice Lead)

**Job Nature –**
Permanent

**Work Location –**
Hyderabad

**Experience –**
12+ years software engineering, of which 2+ years building production large language model / agentic applications and 4+ years leading engineers

**Purpose of the Role**

Own ArcelorMittal's agent engineering practice: reusable patterns for agent decomposition, orchestration, tool use, memory, evaluation, safeguards and operational behaviour; reference implementations on approved Microsoft agent frameworks; agent-specific test suites; and coaching of pod engineers so that agentic solutions are measurable, safe and reusable.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define agent decomposition, planning, tool-use, memory, state and orchestration patterns; codify them in the agent engineering standard.
* Select and validate implementation approaches across approved Microsoft agent frameworks (Azure AI Foundry Agent Service, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, Copilot Studio) and the platform's agent runtime.
* Build and maintain reference implementations and reusable components (tools, connectors, orchestration, guardrails) for common agent behaviours.
* Define agent-specific tests for task success, safety, permissions, latency, cost and failure recovery; integrate them into CI/CD evaluation gates with the AI Platform Owner.
* Review pod implementations, lead code and design reviews, and coach engineers on difficult agent design problems.
* Harvest proven components and lessons from the partner-led pods into the CoE pattern library; retire unsafe or untestable patterns.
* Lead the ArcelorMittal engineering community of practice for agentic AI across Europe and the India Global Capability Centre.

**Preferred Skills**

* Stakeholder orientation
* Results orientation
* Courage to challenge
* Inspire trust
* Innovation and learning agility
* Decision making
* Cross-cultural collaboration
* Capability building and knowledge transfer

**Good to have skills**

* Production software engineering in Python and/or C#/.NET with strong testing and CI/CD discipline
* Hands-on building of large language model / agentic applications: Azure AI Foundry (Azure OpenAI), Agent Service, Semantic Kernel / Agent Framework, function calling / tools, retrieval-augmented generation and grounding
* Agent evaluation and safety engineering: evaluation datasets, model-as-judge evaluation, red-teaming, content safety, permission boundaries
* Designing for observability and operations: tracing (OpenTelemetry), telemetry, cost and latency management
* Technical leadership: code review, pattern definition, coaching
* Experience in leading team of AI Engineers, providing guidance and technical decision ability, defining strong engineering practices
* Copilot Studio and Power Platform for low-code agents; Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility
* Microsoft Fabric / SQL for grounding on governed data
* Container-based runtimes (Azure Container Apps, Azure Kubernetes Service), Azure API Management, Entra ID
* Certifications: AI-102, AZ-204, DP-600

**Qualifications**

Bachelor degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Data, Business or a relevant discipline. Advanced degree or equivalent professional experience is an advantage

**Deliverables**

The successful Agentic AI Engineering Lead (Agent Engineering Practice Lead) combines strong professional depth with a practical delivery mindset. The individual must be able to establish clear methods, make sound decisions, develop colleagues and progressively assume ownership from the implementation partner. Success requires confidence working across India and Europe and balanced judgement across delivery speed, reuse, security and Responsible AI.

title: Staff AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.
  
  
At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.
  
  
Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.
  
  
If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.
  
  
**Location:**
While this role is open to remote candidates across India, team members located near our Bengaluru office (Wilshire III by MFAR, 492, Hobli, RHB Colony, Mahadevapura, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048) are expected to work onsite four days per week, with the potential to increase to five days per week to support collaboration, speed, and execution.
  
  
Nextiva is looking for a
**Staff AI Engineer**
to help build an internal AI platform that will shape how we work across engineering and the broader organization.
  
  
This is a
**Staff-level, hands-on individual contributor role**
at the intersection of backend/platform engineering, system architecture, AI, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity. You’ll design and build production-grade agentic workflows across the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and intelligent automation that improves engineering and business processes across Nextiva.
  
  
Working across Nextiva’s technology platform, you’ll identify high-value opportunities, architect solutions, and take them from concept through
**deployment, operationalization, security, observability, and scale**
. You’ll also provide technical leadership and influence across engineering teams.
  
  
We are looking for an engineer who understands that
**AI is a means to a business outcome—not the outcome itself**
and can turn promising capabilities into reliable systems that create measurable value.
  
  
**Top 3 Outcomes (first 12 months)**

* Build and operationalize agentic SDLC capabilities: Architect and deliver production-grade AI workflows that materially improve how Nextiva engineers design, build, test, review, deploy, operate, and maintain software, with measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness.
* Establish a scalable internal AI platform: Develop reusable architecture, services, infrastructure, patterns, and guardrails that enable AI-powered workflows to move reliably from experimentation into secure, observable, production-scale operation.
* Deliver measurable business impact through AI and automation: Identify and execute high-value automation opportunities across engineering and business processes, establishing clear success metrics and demonstrating tangible improvements in productivity, quality, velocity, cost, or customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, build, deploy, and operate production-grade AI systems and agentic workflows across the SDLC and broader business processes.
* Design scalable internal platform capabilities that enable teams across Nextiva to safely and efficiently adopt AI-powered automation.
* Own solutions end-to-end—from problem definition and architecture through implementation, deployment, observability, security, scaling, and ongoing operation.
* Build robust integrations between AI models, agents, developer tooling, internal platforms, enterprise systems, APIs, data sources, and engineering workflows.
* Apply strong software engineering principles to AI systems, including modular architecture, testing, reliability, performance, maintainability, and fault tolerance.
* Design approaches for AI evaluation, observability, quality measurement, failure handling, and continuous improvement in production.
* Make pragmatic architectural and technology decisions based on business outcomes, engineering constraints, risk, and total cost of ownership rather than technology trends.
* Work deeply within GCP and/or AWS, designing cloud-native architectures and infrastructure capable of supporting secure, reliable, scalable production workloads.
* Partner with infrastructure, DevOps, security, architecture, and engineering teams to establish reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and operational guardrails for AI-powered systems.
* Understand complex software systems and large codebases to identify opportunities where AI can improve developer workflows across the end-to-end SDLC.
* Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, agent architectures, and developer technologies to determine where they can create meaningful value for Nextiva.
* Provide Staff-level technical leadership through architecture reviews, design decisions, technical mentorship, and influence across engineering teams.
* Translate ambiguous business and engineering problems into clear technical strategies and executable solutions, measuring and optimizing impact based on production data, user feedback, and business results.

**Requirements**
**Must-have**

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating complex production-scale systems.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience designing and building AI/ML or generative AI solutions that have reached production and/or delivered measurable business outcomes.
* Strong software architecture and system design skills, including experience making consequential technical decisions for distributed or large-scale systems.
* Strong programming and software engineering fundamentals in one or more production languages such as Java, Python, Go, or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience working with LLMs, generative AI, AI agents, or AI-enabled application architectures, beyond simply consuming AI productivity tools.
* Experience taking AI solutions beyond prototypes into deployment, operationalization, monitoring, security, reliability, and scale.
* Deep hands-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, including designing and operating cloud-native production systems—not solely familiarity with cloud services or consoles.
* Strong understanding of DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of application, infrastructure, data, and AI security considerations and the ability to incorporate appropriate controls into system architecture.
* Strong understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, developer workflows, and the challenges of working within large software systems and codebases.
* Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and select technologies based on the problem, desired business outcome, operational requirements, and long-term maintainability.
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, cross-functional problem spaces.
* Ability to influence technical direction across teams without relying solely on organizational authority.

**Preferred**

* Experience designing or implementing agentic AI systems, multi-step AI workflows, tool-using agents, or autonomous/semi-autonomous engineering workflows.
* Experience applying AI to developer productivity, software engineering, code generation, testing, code review, incident management, or other stages of the SDLC.
* Experience building internal developer platforms, engineering productivity platforms, or enterprise automation capabilities.
* Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, model/agent observability, prompt and context management, retrieval architectures, and production AI quality measurement.
* Experience spanning traditional software engineering and AI engineering—for example, a strong backend, platform, or distributed-systems engineering foundation combined with substantial hands-on AI engineering experience.
* Experience driving technical initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or organizational domains.

**Tools & Tech Stack**
The Exact Stack Will Evolve As We Select Technologies Based On The Problems And Outcomes We Are Solving. Relevant Experience May Include
  
  

* Cloud: GCP and/or AWS
* Languages: Java, Python, Go, and/or equivalent production engineering languages
* AI: LLMs, generative AI, agentic frameworks and architectures, model APIs, evaluation and observability tooling
* Platform & Infrastructure: Containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, cloud-native services
* Engineering: APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures, observability and developer tooling
* Security: Cloud security, identity and access management, secrets management, secure application and AI architecture

**Nextiva DNA**
(Core Competencies)
  
  
Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:
  
  

* Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
* Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.
* Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.

**Total Rewards**
Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow our employees to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.
  
  
Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.
  
  

* Medical 🩺 - Medical insurance coverage is available for employees, their spouse, and up to two dependent children with a limit of 500,000 INR, as well as their parents or in-laws for up to 300,000 INR. This comprehensive coverage ensures that essential healthcare needs are met for the entire family unit, providing peace of mind and security in times of medical necessity.
* Group Term & Group Personal Accident Insurance 💼 - Provides insurance coverage against the risk of death / injury during the policy period sustained due to an accident caused by violent, visible & external means.

+ Coverage Type - Employee Only
+ Sum Insured - 3 times of annual CTC with minimum cap of INR 10,00,000
+ Free Cover Limit - 1.5 Crore

* Wellness 🤸‍ - Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives
* Growth 🌱 - Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
****About InvoiceCloud**
:**
InvoiceCloud is a fast-growing fintech leader recognized with 20 major awards in 2025, including USA TODAY and Boston Globe Top Workplaces, multiple SaaS Awards wins for Best Solution for Finance and FinTech, and national customer service honors from Stevie and the Business Intelligence Group. Judges also highlighted our mission to reduce digital exclusion and restore simplicity and dignity to how people pay for essential services, as well as our leadership in AI maturity and responsible innovation. It’s an award-winning, purpose-driven environment where top talent thrives. To learn more, visit InvoiceCloud.com.
  
  
**About InvoiceCloud**
InvoiceCloud is the leading digital payments platform for utilities, insurance carriers, municipalities, and financial institutions. We enable billers to present bills digitally and collect payments across every channel — driving digital adoption, reducing costs, and improving the customer experience. With 3,000+ billing organizations, 240M+ invoices, and $38B+ in annual payment volume, we're investing heavily in AI to transform from a best-in-class payments processor into a Billing Intelligence Platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're building a shared AI platform that powers the next generation of our product portfolio — multi-agent orchestration, ML scoring infrastructure, and LLM-powered intelligence products. As Principal AI Engineer, you'll architect this platform, set the technical direction, and define the engineering standards that the organization builds against.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role — not a management position. You set architectural direction and write production code every day. You think in ADRs, trade-off matrices, and failure modes. You use Claude Code and AI accelerators to operate at 3–5x speed, and you teach the team to do the same.
  
  
Your work directly shapes a growing AI product portfolio. The platform you architect becomes the shared foundation — every subsequent product launches faster because of the infrastructure decisions you make now.
  
  
You'll be based in India, working hybrid (3 days in-office per week), and will report to the VP of Engineering / CTO.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
****Own AI Platform Architecture :****

* Design the full AI platform — multi-agent orchestration, ML inference infrastructure, LLM gateway, tool registry, and eval/observability stack
* Write Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) that the organization builds against
* Make build-vs-buy decisions, evaluate emerging frameworks (A2A, MCP, Visa TAP), and define integration patterns
* Design system-level concerns: auth gating, policy enforcement (OPA), API gateway patterns (Kong), and multi-tenant isolation
* Define reference architectures for AI-enabled services across .NET 10 APIs, Python ML workloads, React frontends, AKS deployments, Kong gateway integration, and Azure DevOps delivery pipelines

****Drive Product AI Strategy :****

* Partner with Product and CTO office to translate business objectives into AI technical strategy
* Identify where AI creates differentiated value — predictive models, conversational agents, intelligent automation
* Evaluate and de-risk emerging technologies. Present to executive leadership on AI capabilities, costs, and competitive positioning
* Define the AI FinOps strategy: token metering, model routing for cost optimization, quota management, and budget forecasting
* Establish clear platform decision rules for when AI capabilities should be implemented as .NET services, Python services, Azure ML pipelines, background jobs, or embedded product workflows

****AI Safety, Governance And Responsible AI :****

* Define and enforce the Responsible AI framework — content safety guardrails, PII governance, bias testing, and audit trails
* Ensure all AI systems meet PCI DSS, SOC 2, and emerging AI regulation requirements
* Establish model validation and governance processes — transparency, explainability, and fairness are non-negotiable
* Build the trust infrastructure that enables the organization to deploy AI confidently in regulated financial services
* Champion ethical AI principles; ensure all agents and models comply with global financial regulations and internal compliance standards

****Write Code - Everyday :****

* Write production code, review critical PRs, debug complex agent interactions, and prototype new capabilities
* Lead by example — your code quality, testing discipline, and documentation set the standard
* Use Claude Code and AI accelerators daily. Build custom skills, MCP integrations, and automation workflows

****Mentor And Multiply The Team :****

* Raise the AI engineering bar across the organization. Run design reviews, pair on complex problems
* Champion AI-accelerated development — train the team on Claude Code workflows, custom skills, and agentic tooling
* Define engineering standards, evaluation criteria, and best practices that scale beyond your direct team

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* 10+ years in software engineering with 5+ years in AI/ML — you've architected and shipped production AI systems
* System design mastery — multi-agent architectures, ML platforms, or large-scale inference systems
* Azure + Microsoft AI stack deep expertise — Azure ML, AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, .NET agent frameworks
* Python + .NET bilingual — Python for ML/data, .NET/C# for agent runtimes
* LLM systems at production scale — prompt management, RAG, content safety, agentic workflows
* AI-first development velocity — Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent at 3–5x speed
* Deep experience architecting modern .NET cloud-native platforms — including API-first service design, distributed systems, Kubernetes deployment, gateway integration, and CI/CD governance

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* FinTech / Payments architecture — PCI DSS, SOC 2, regulated AI
* Agentic Commerce & A2A — Google A2A, MCP, Visa TAP
* Technical leadership track record — mentored teams, ADR processes, C-level presentations
* Omnichannel & voice AI — web chat, voice, SMS, Azure Communication Services
* ML platform engineering — model registries, feature stores, drift detection
* Published or open-source contributions in AI/ML

Education
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, Mathematics, or a related technical field required. A Master's degree is preferred — but we value what you've built and the systems you've architected over credentials.
